Ausgehend von der Backerei und Konditorei der Familie Weigel nehmen die Geschichten um Freundschaft, Liebe, Intrigen und geplatzte Traume ihren Lauf. Dabei steht die Familie Weigel, die eine Konditorei im Erdgeschoss betreibt und mit drei Generationen im Haus lebt, im Mittelpunkt. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.desc: The largest League competition in Italy was founded in 1898. programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije

The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 matches. Out of a total of eight teams that select the Plejof two best play "World Series Final". The winner is the one who arrives first to four victories in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Maria Gigova / Зала на славата: Мария Гигова
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Arsenal - Dinamo Zagreb, Football, Champions League / Arsenal - Dinamo Zagreb, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program, 2025) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a Championship Cup was founded, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program, 2025) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Fuchse - Nantes, Rukomet, EHF LP
programme.desc: Ehf Champions League - (Sport. Program, 2025) from September 11, 2024 to June 15, 2025, a champion EHF league that brings together the 16 best handball clubs from all over Europe. The final four games will be held at the Lanxes Arena in Kolno, Germany, June 14 and 15, 2025. Follow the great matches and find out which club will be the best! ... / EHF Champions League - (sport. program, 2025) Od 11. rujna 2024. do 15. lipnja 2025. godine održava se EHF Liga prvaka koja okuplja 16 najboljih rukometnih klubova iz cijele Europe. Finalne četiri utakmice će se održati u Lanxess Areni u Kolnu, Njemačka, 14. i 15. lipnja 2025. godine. Pratite sjajne utakmice i saznajte koji će klub biti najbolji!...

programme.desc: Ligue 1 McDonalds - (Sport. Program, France, 2025) From August 15, 2025 to May 2026, Ligue 1, the best French football league. The last three seasons have won the cult Paris Saint-Germain. Follow the great games, always interesting turns and find out which club will be the best! ... / Ligue 1 McDonalds - (sport. program, Francuska, 2025) Od 15. kolovoza 2025. do svibnja 2026. godine traje Ligue 1, najbolja francuska nogometna liga. Zadnje tri sezone pobjedu je odnio kultni Paris Saint-Germain. Pratite sjajne utakmice, uvijek zanimljive obrate i saznajte koji će klub biti najbolji!...

programme.desc: Lega Basket Serie A - (Sport Program, Italy, 2025) Lega Basket Serie A 2024/2025 season brings another exciting fight for the best team of Italy. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Nogomet: SuperSport Prva nogometna liga
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program) The First Football League is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: Ein Luftikus zum Verlieben
programme.desc: At first glance, Munchner management consultant Max Tanner (Heio von Stetten) is a real dream type: attractive, successful and charming. However, Max is also an incorrigible Luftikus and Casanova. This does not want to admit his new girlfriend, the illustrator Anna (Sophie Schutt), of course, because she is in love with Max to both ears. All warnings of her little daughter Lilli (Marie Bruns) and her friend Magda (Karin Gregorek) hit her in the wind - until Max puts her on her birthday, of all things to go out with a lecturer. When Anna also caught him in Flagranti, she puts her on the spot with Max and cursed him with the words "From now on you are air!" What Anna has no idea: her words will come true! When Max comes to the BURO at the next day, he has to find horror that no one perceives him! However, as an invisible, he finds out some unpleasant truths: his colleagues, who otherwise admired him so much, are in truth over his countless affarities; His friend and partner Robert (Florian Fitz) steals his ideas and tries to take over the company. He also uses Max Plotzliche "disappear" to make sure of Anna. Only now does Max gradually understand how much Anna really means. He searches feverishly for a way to become visible again and to ask Anna to forgive - in vain. Only when he preserves little Lilli from a serious accident can he at least see him again. And although the girl has never been able to stand it, Max manages to get her to help him. But Anna does not believe her daughter when she tries to explain her Max predicament. Incidentally, however, there are also the advantages of its invisibility. Max Lilli can save Einagen and Anna from the advances of a greasy publisher at school. However, when Robert is standing by Anna's hand and she takes the application to the extent, everything seems lost for Max. Anna also has to admit that, despite his mistakes, she simply cannot forget. But the wedding preparations are already in full swing. At the last second, the sophisticated Lilli has an idea of a daring idea to thwart the marriage, banish the "curse" and to bring Max and Anna together. / Auf den ersten Blick ist der Munchner Unternehmensberater Max Tanner (Heio von Stetten) ein echter Traumtyp: attraktiv, erfolgreich und charmant. Allerdings ist Max auch ein unverbesserlicher Luftikus und Casanova. Dies will seine neue Freundin, die Illustratorin Anna (Sophie Schutt), naturlich nicht wahrhaben, denn sie ist bis uber beide Ohren in Max verliebt. Alle Warnungen ihrer kleinen Tochter Lilli (Marie Bruns) und ihrer Freundin Magda (Karin Gregorek) schlagt sie in den Wind - bis Max sie ausgerechnet an ihrem Geburtstag versetzt, um mit einer verfuhrerischen Geschaftspartnerin auszugehen. Als die enttauschte Anna ihn dabei auch noch in flagranti ertappt, macht sie auf der Stelle mit Max Schluss und verflucht ihn mit den Worten "Von nun an bist du Luft!" Was Anna nicht ahnt: Ihre Worte werden wahr! Als Max am nachsten Tag ins Buro kommt, muss er voller Entsetzen feststellen, dass ihn kein Mensch wahrnimmt! Er selbst findet als unsichtbarer Zuhorer jedoch einige unangenehme Wahrheiten heraus: Seine Kolleginnen, die ihn sonst so bewundert haben, lastern in Wahrheit uber seine zahllosen Affaren; sein Freund und Partner Robert (Florian Fitz) klaut seine Ideen und versucht, die Firma zu ubernehmen. AuSSerdem nutzt er Max plotzliches "Verschwinden", um sich an Anna heranzumachen. Erst jetzt begreift Max allmahlich, wie viel ihm Anna wirklich bedeutet. Fieberhaft sucht er nach einem Weg, um wieder sichtbar zu werden und Anna um Verzeihung zu bitten - vergeblich. Erst als er die kleine Lilli vor einem schweren Unfall bewahrt, kann wenigstens diese ihn wieder sehen. Und obwohl das Madchen ihn eigentlich noch nie ausstehen konnte, gelingt es Max, sie dazu zu bewegen, ihm zu helfen. Doch Anna glaubt ihrer Tochter kein Wort, als diese versucht, ihr Max missliche Lage zu erklaren. Ganz nebenbei zeigen sich allerdings auch die Vorzuge seiner Unsichtbarkeit. So kann Max Lilli in der Schule einsagen und Anna vor den Avancen eines schmierigen Verlegers retten. Als Robert jedoch um Annas Hand anhalt und diese zogernd den Antrag annimmt, scheint fur Max alles verloren. Dabei muss sich auch Anna eingestehen, dass sie Max trotz seiner Fehler einfach nicht vergessen kann. Aber die Hochzeitsvorbereitungen laufen bereits auf Hochtouren. Da hat die gewitzte Lilli in letzter Sekunde eine im wahrsten Sinne waghalsige Idee, um die EheschlieSSung zu vereiteln, den "Fluch" zu bannen und Max und Anna doch noch zusammenzubringen.

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: A young blogger is found dead in her apartment. She died of a mixture of alcohol and a sprayed dose of ketamine. A first trace goes to the horse breeder Pascal Raat. The clearly old, married man had an affara with the girl. But Raat asserts his innocence. But is it just a coincidence that he claims to have broke up with his beloved on the night of death? The suspicion against him is getting on when the commissioners find that ketamine is used frequently to narcotize horses. programme.title: Two at the Gross Lake - attack on paradise / Zwei am groSSen See - Angriff aufs Paradies
programme.desc: The "Small Hotel am Grossen Lake" is now running well. The satisfied guest enjoy direct sea access and let the lovable service in the homely furnished old villa. Antonia (Uschi Glas) and Regina (Ruth Drexel) hardly come to a breath. When Regina, who is no longer the youngest, is given a break from the family doctor after a weak cap, she spends the vacation deserved - where else? - in your own hotel. While you critically inspected the hotel service, the elegantly world bumper Maximilian von Lauenberg (Hans Peter Korff) takes her beautiful eyes. So that not enough, the construction machinery suddenly thundered behind the hotel, so that all wine carpayers tumble out of the shelf. Behind the martial campaign is once more Bartholomaus Breitwieser (Gerd Anthoff). Her ore competitor wants to install Antonia and Regina the beautiful view and, although the neighboring foundation, does not even belong to him, for the time being "trial bores". In the event of a fluid, the shreds scared by the LAMM leave the hotel, and now it will be tight for the two indebted women who are dependent on each cent. In order to stop Breitwieser, Antonia decides to flee to the front: the two women want to buy the base from the competitor in front of their nose. But they have to take another loan. Sparkasse director pioneer (Alexander Held) accommodates Antonia and Regina with a high -quality offer. / Das "Kleine Hotel am groSSen See" lauft inzwischen bestens. Die zufriedenen Gaste genieSSen den direkten Seezugang und lassen sich von dem liebenswurdigen Service in der heimelig eingerichteten alten Villa verwohnen. So kommen Antonia (Uschi Glas) und Regina (Ruth Drexel) kaum noch zum Verschnaufen. Als Regina, die ja nicht mehr die Jungste ist, nach einem Schwacheanfall vom Hausarzt eine Pause verordnet bekommt, verbringt sie den verdienten Urlaub - wo sonst? - im eigenen Hotel. Wahrend sie dabei den Hotelservice kritisch inspiziert, macht der elegant auftretende Weltenbummler Maximilian von Lauenberg (Hans Peter Korff) ihr schone Augen. Regina ahnt noch nicht, dass der verarmte Adlige auf der Suche nach einer guten Partie ist. Damit nicht genug, donnern direkt hinter dem Hotel plotzlich die Baumaschinen los, so dass alle Weinkaraffen aus dem Regal purzeln. Hinter der martialischen Aktion steckt einmal mehr Bartholomaus Breitwieser (Gerd Anthoff). Ihr Erzkonkurrent will Antonia und Regina die schone Aussicht verbauen und lasst, obwohl das Nachbargrundstuck ihm noch nicht gar gehort, einstweilen "Probebohrungen" durchfuhren. Fluchtartig verlassen die vom Larm verschreckten Gaste das Hotel, und nun wird es eng fur die beiden verschuldeten Frauen, die auf jeden Cent angewiesen sind. Um Breitwieser zu stoppen, beschlieSSt Antonia die Flucht nach vorne: Die beiden Frauen wollen dem Konkurrenten das Grundstuck vor der Nase wegkaufen. Doch dazu mussen sie einen weiteren Kredit aufnehmen. Sparkassendirektor Vorreiter (Alexander Held) kommt Antonia und Regina mit einem verraterisch groSSzugigen Angebot entgegen.

programme.title: Die Fischerin
programme.desc: Single parent Meike (Alwara Hofels) has her life under control: she lives in Berlin with her son Paul (Joshio Oenicke), has a loving friend in the Koch Sascha (Max von Thun), and soon she will take over the custody of a small scene cafe. One evening, however, she received a call from her home village: her father Erich (Rudiger Vogler), a Lake Constance fisherman, came to the hospital after a heart attack. Many years ago, the contact with him broke off by Meike's move to Berlin. In this situation, however, there is no question for her: Together with Paul, she immediately makes her way to Suddeutschland to get around her father. But he is already on his feet again and is not very pleased to see the surprising reunion with his daughter: he still blames her to the death of her brother, who once drowned in the lake in a fishing accident. Erich's advance and Meike's gnawing guilty fuss had also run for their escape to Berlin. Now the gnarled fisherman stubbornly refuses to accept help from his daughter. Nevertheless, Erich cannot hide his joy over the first encounter with his grandson Paul. He is not the only one who is surprised by the boy's existence: after all the years, Meike confesses to her childhood love Markus (Golo Euler) that he is Paul's father. It doesn't take long for the bright boy to develop a trusting relationship with father and grandpa. Meike, on the other hand, is creating confrontation with her more early life. An amusement with Erich seems hardly possible, on the contrary: the smoldering conflict continues to come to a head. At the same time, the old floats become awake between her and Markus. In this difficult situation, Sascha appears in the village. When trying to reconcile her past and new life, Meike is becoming increasingly clear that she has to make a decision. / Die alleinerziehende Meike (Alwara Hofels) hat ihr Leben fest im Griff: Sie wohnt mit ihrem Sohn Paul (Joshio Oenicke) in Berlin, hat in dem Koch Sascha (Max von Thun) einen liebevollen Freund, und bald soll sie die Geschaftsfuhrung eines kleinen Szene-Cafes ubernehmen. Eines Abends erhalt sie jedoch einen Anruf aus ihrem Heimatdorf: Ihr Vater Erich (Rudiger Vogler), ein Bodenseefischer, kam nach einem Herzinfarkt ins Krankenhaus. Schon vor vielen Jahren war durch Meikes Umzug nach Berlin der Kontakt zu ihm abgebrochen. In dieser Situation aber gibt es fur sie keine Frage: Zusammen mit Paul macht sie sich sofort auf den Weg nach Suddeutschland, um sich um ihren Vater zu kummern. Der ist aber schon wieder auf den Beinen und reagiert wenig erfreut auf das uberraschende Wiedersehen mit seiner Tochter: Er gibt ihr noch immer die Schuld am Tod ihres Bruders, der einst bei einem Fischereiunfall im See ertrank. Erichs Vorwurfe und Meikes nagende Schuldgefuhle hatten damals auch zu ihrer Flucht nach Berlin gefuhrt. Nun weigert sich der knorrige Fischer stur, Hilfe von seiner Tochter anzunehmen. Trotzdem kann Erich seine Freude uber die erstmalige Begegnung mit seinem Enkelsohn Paul nicht verbergen. Er ist nicht der Einzige, der von der Existenz des Jungen uberrascht wird: Nach all den Jahren gesteht Meike ihrer Jugendliebe Markus (Golo Euler), dass er Pauls Vater ist. Es dauert nicht lange, bis der aufgeweckte Junge ein vertrauensvolles Verhaltnis zu Vater und Opa entwickelt. Meike hingegen macht die Konfrontation mit ihrem fruheren Leben zu schaffen. Eine Aussohnung mit Erich scheint kaum moglich, im Gegenteil: Der schwelende Konflikt spitzt sich immer weiter zu. Zugleich werden zwischen ihr und Markus die alten Gefuhle wieder wach. In dieser schwierigen Situation taucht uberraschend Sascha im Dorf auf. Beim Versuch, ihre Vergangenheit und ihr neues Leben in Einklang zu bringen, wird Meike immer klarer, dass sie eine Entscheidung treffen muss.

programme.title: Digital fainting - Germany in the spell of Big Tech / Digitale Ohnmacht - Deutschland im Bann von Big Tech
programme.desc: Germany and Europe have lost control in digital. US platforms such as X, Facebook and Instagram determine what we see, what we discuss. Our vacation photos, private news and professional documents are large parts of the US companies servers. But all of them are neither democratically legitimized nor bound to European law. And now the tech billionaries are also fusing a power elite with the Trump government. How could it get that far and what else can save us? The journalists Nadia Kailouli and Daniel Brockerhoff reconstruct for this documentary together with a reporter team The wrong decisions of the past 30 years, politicians, experts and dropouts from the tech scene and questions how Germany and Europe can relapse their digital sovereignty. From one of the greatest media groups in Europe, the Axel Springer publishing house. He already saw Fruh a role model in the US tech corporations, stealing contacts in Silicon Valley. He thinks the hope of a German or European counter -model for naive: "To be honest, that was not brave and keen to risk, but a bit of reality content and Gaga." The EU now wants to limit this market dominance. The Digital Markets Act (DMA) should force the platforms to fairness and competition - and in doubt. The German MEP Alexandra Geese (Bundnis 90/Die Grunen) is fighting for this. The documentation accompanies Geese to the USA, at the center of power according to Washington D.C. Their mission is to advertise the European ideas: "Especially on the democratic side and those who have a critical look at some practices of these tech companies, the hope is very great that the solution will come from Europe." Many Republicans see them more enemy in them and the EU. But Geese is driven by idealism and conviction: Europe has to counter the US tech corporations. On Twitter he was state -of -the -art political contacts in Germany and experienced from Nachster how the platform changed after Elon Musk took it. In this documentation, he gives a detailed interview for the first time in the company. Weimert describes the change of course as radical: "It was an 180-degree application." The attempt to reconcile freedom of expression and compliance with legal requirements has been increasingly undermined. Today he is increasingly seeing the platform as a counter -model to its more early principles. Calculation, dependency and departure, the documentary "digital power of power" is relieved of a democracy in the digital stress test. / Deutschland und Europa haben die Kontrolle im Digitalen verloren. US-Plattformen wie X, Facebook und Instagram bestimmen, was wir sehen, woruber wir diskutieren. Unsere Urlaubsfotos, private Nachrichten und berufliche Dokumente liegen zu groSSen Teilen auf den Servern von US-Unternehmen. Aber sie alle sind weder demokratisch legitimiert noch an europaisches Recht gebunden. Und jetzt verschmelzen die Tech-Milliardare auch noch mit der Trump-Regierung zu einer Machtelite. Wie konnte es so weit kommen und was kann uns jetzt noch retten?Die Journalist*innen Nadia Kailouli und Daniel Brockerhoff rekonstruieren fur diese Dokumentation gemeinsam mit einem Reporter-Team die Fehlentscheidungen der vergangenen 30 Jahre, treffen Politiker, Experten und Aussteiger aus der Tech-Szene und fragen, wie Deutschland und Europa ihre digitale Souveranitat zuruckerobern konnen.Mathias Dopfner ist Chef von einem der groSSten Medienkonzerne Europas, dem Axel-Springer-Verlag. Schon fruh sah er in den US-Tech-Konzernen ein Vorbild, knupfte Kontakte ins Silicon Valley. Heute beurteilt er die Dominanz von Google, Meta und Co. allerdings kritisch - auch wenn er deren Innovationskraft schatzt. "Bei einem Marktanteil von 95 Prozent gibt es de facto keine Alternative", sagt Dopfner im Interview. Die Hoffnung auf ein deutsches oder europaisches Gegenmodell halt er fur naiv: "Das ware ehrlich gesagt als Plan nicht mutig und risikofreudig, sondern ein bisschen realitatsentruckt und gaga."Diese Marktdominanz will die EU nun begrenzen. Der Digital Markets Act (DMA) soll die Plattformen zu Fairness und Wettbewerb zwingen - und im Zweifel bestrafen. Dafur kampft die deutsche EU-Abgeordnete Alexandra Geese (Bundnis 90/Die Grunen). Die Dokumentation begleitet Geese in die USA, ins Zentrum der Macht nach Washington D.C. Ihre Mission ist es, Werbung zu machen fur die europaischen Ideen: "Gerade auf der demokratischen Seite und bei denjenigen, die einen kritischen Blick auf einige Praktiken dieser Tech-Unternehmen haben, ist die Hoffnung sehr groSS, dass die Losung aus Europa kommt." Viele Republikanerinnen und Republikaner sehen in ihr und der EU mehr Feind als Partner. Aber Geese wird getrieben von Idealismus und der Überzeugung: Europa muss den US-Tech-Konzernen etwas entgegensetzen.Welchen Einfluss die neue politische Richtung in den USA auf ein Tech-Unternehmen haben kann, weiSS er: Daniel Weimert. Er war bei Twitter fur die politischen Kontakte in Deutschland zustandig und erlebte aus nachster Nahe, wie sich die Plattform veranderte, nachdem Elon Musk sie ubernahm. In dieser Dokumentation gibt er erstmals ein ausfuhrliches Interview uber seine Zeit im Unternehmen. Weimert beschreibt den Kurswechsel als radikal: "Es war eine 180-Grad-Wendung." Der Versuch, Meinungsfreiheit und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben in Einklang zu bringen, sei zunehmend untergraben worden. Heute sieht er die Plattform zunehmend als ein Gegenmodell zu ihren fruheren Prinzipien.Zwischen Krise, Abhangigkeit und Aufbruch erzahlt die Dokumentation "Digitale Ohnmacht" von einer Demokratie im digitalen Stresstest.

programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.desc: She was once known as a "black Heidi" on the comedy Buhne - loud, fast, polarizing. Today Jeniffer Morland runs three restaurants in Berlin, which are still carrying their art learning names. But the path from the grave to the gastronomy was not a planned step in the career, but an escape from pain. As Jeniffer's beloved stepfather died, her laugh fell silent. The grave became a place where it could no longer be. Life continued to demand: Personnel shortage, financial problems, worried about the existence of her restaurants. But now she wants to go back to herself, back to herself. But times have changed. Is it still funny? The film accompanies Jeniffer Morland aka the "Black Heidi" at her unusual fresh start. We experience how she writes her texts between Kuche, Comedybuhne and Family, prepared appearances, places backstream - and waxed beyond. We travel to Switzerland with her to her mother, where she grew up and was faced with racism as a black girl. Her late stepfather is also buried there. We see her in the spinning room, where she trains herself and her school, and feverish with her first open mic, where she finally laughs on her gray again - with and about herself. The film is the film between a woman who is not a perfect heroine - but a real one. And which has not been less than the following year with the best comedians in Germany to be on a gray. If you succeed in the big comeback? A film about laughter, pain and fresh start. And the courage to start again at zero - in the middle of life. / Sie war einst als "Schwarze Heidi" auf der Comedy-Buhne bekannt - laut, schnell, polarisierend. Heute fuhrt Jeniffer Morland in Berlin drei Restaurants, die noch immer ihren Kunstlernamen tragen. Doch der Weg von der Buhne in die Gastronomie war kein geplanter Karriereschritt, sondern eine Flucht vor dem Schmerz.Als Jeniffers geliebter Stiefvater starb, verstummte ihr Lachen. Die Buhne wurde zu einem Ort, an dem sie nicht mehr sein konnte. Das Leben forderte sie weiter: Personalnot, Finanzprobleme, Sorgen um die Existenz ihrer Restaurants. Doch jetzt will sie zuruck auf die Buhne, zuruck zu sich selbst. Aber die Zeiten haben sich geandert. Ist sie noch lustig?Der Film begleitet Jeniffer Morland aka die "Schwarze Heidi" bei ihrem ungewohnlichen Neuanfang. Wir erleben, wie sie zwischen Kuche, Comedybuhne und Familie ihre Texte schreibt, Auftritte vorbereitet, Ruckschlage einsteckt - und uber sich hinauswachst. Wir reisen mit ihr in die Schweiz zu ihrer Mutter, wo sie aufgewachsen ist und als Schwarzes Madchen mit Rassismus konfrontiert war. Auch ihr verstorbener Stiefvater liegt dort begraben. Wir sehen sie im Spinningraum, wo sie sich und ihre Schuler trainiert, und fiebern mit bei ihrem ersten Open Mic, wo sie endlich wieder auf der Buhne lacht - mit und uber sich selbst.Zwischen wirtschaftlichem Druck und kunstlerischem Aufbruch erzahlt der Film von einer Frau, die keine perfekte Heldin ist - aber eine echte. Und die sich nicht weniger vorgenommen hat, als nachstes Jahr mit den besten Comedians Deutschlands auf einer Buhne zu stehen. Gelingt ihr das groSSe Comeback?Ein Film uber Lachen, Schmerz und Neuanfang. Und den Mut, noch einmal bei null anzufangen - mitten im Leben.

In der Notaufnahme herrscht ein riesiger Andrang. Vera Bader wird dehydriert und verwirrt eingeliefert. Lilly nimmt Vera stationar auf, da deren Demenzerkrankung inzwischen weit fortgeschritten ist. Daneben halt der Fall des zwolfjahrigen Luis das Team der Sachsenklinik auf Trab. Der Junge leider seit seiner Geburt an einer Gallengangsatresie, die dazu fuhrt, dass er dringend eine Lebertransplantation benotigt. Nur widerwillig kontaktiert Luis alleinerziehender Vater Daniel die psychisch erkrankte, aber inzwischen medikamentos eingestellte Mutter Ramona. Als Spenderin kommt sie allerdings nicht in Frage. Daniel hingegen scheidet aufgrund seiner HIV-Infektion nach deutschem Recht als Organspender aus. Die Ärzteschaft ist daruber gespalten. Roland kontaktiert Achim Kreutzer in Sudafrika, der dort bereits eine vergleichbare Transplantation durchgefuhrt hat. Roland und Kathrin wollen Luis und seinen Vater nach Sudafrika fliegen lassen. Doch so weit kommt es nicht: Ramona, die von der Entscheidung komplett ausgeschlossen wird, entfuhrt Luis kurzerhand aus der Sachsenklinik, spontan begleitet von Kathrin.Dass der Ausflug ein Fehler war, realisiert Ramona, als ihr Sohn kollabiert. Übersturzt will sie Hilfe holen und hat dabei einen schweren Autounfall. Inzwischen ist Roland, der eine SMS von Kathrin abfangen konnte, mit Martin auf dem Weg zu ihnen. Er findet die verungluckte Ramona und versorgt sie, Kathrin ist bei Luis am See. Zuruck in der Klinik wird Ramona operiert und Luis stabilisiert. Wahrenddessen hat Maria eine andere Losung fur Luis gefunden: eine Ringspende. Doch erst nachdem sich seine Eltern auf Drangen von Luis versohnen, stimmt auch der Junge der anstehenden OP zu. Bei der aufwendigen Cross-Over Spende retten die Ärzte schlieSSlich nicht nur Luis das Leben. Als am Ende ein rauschendes Fest der Liebe und Freundschaft mit allen Beteiligten gefeiert wird, fangt es endlich an zu regnen.

programme.title: Echtes Leben
programme.desc: She was once known as a "black Heidi" on the comedy Buhne - loud, fast, polarizing. Today Jeniffer Morland runs three restaurants in Berlin, which are still carrying their art learning names. But the path from the grave to the gastronomy was not a planned step in the career, but an escape from pain. As Jeniffer's beloved stepfather died, her laugh fell silent. The grave became a place where it could no longer be. Life continued to demand: Personnel shortage, financial problems, worried about the existence of her restaurants. But now she wants to go back to herself, back to herself. But times have changed. Is it still funny? The film accompanies Jeniffer Morland aka the "Black Heidi" at her unusual fresh start. We experience how she writes her texts between Kuche, Comedybuhne and Family, prepared appearances, places backstream - and waxed beyond. We travel to Switzerland with her to her mother, where she grew up and was faced with racism as a black girl. Her late stepfather is also buried there. We see her in the spinning room, where she trains herself and her school, and feverish with her first open mic, where she finally laughs on her gray again - with and about herself. The film is the film between a woman who is not a perfect heroine - but a real one. And which has not been less than the following year with the best comedians in Germany to be on a gray. If you succeed in the big comeback? A film about laughter, pain and fresh start. And the courage to start again at zero - in the middle of life. / Sie war einst als "Schwarze Heidi" auf der Comedy-Buhne bekannt - laut, schnell, polarisierend. Heute fuhrt Jeniffer Morland in Berlin drei Restaurants, die noch immer ihren Kunstlernamen tragen. Doch der Weg von der Buhne in die Gastronomie war kein geplanter Karriereschritt, sondern eine Flucht vor dem Schmerz.Als Jeniffers geliebter Stiefvater starb, verstummte ihr Lachen. Die Buhne wurde zu einem Ort, an dem sie nicht mehr sein konnte. Das Leben forderte sie weiter: Personalnot, Finanzprobleme, Sorgen um die Existenz ihrer Restaurants. Doch jetzt will sie zuruck auf die Buhne, zuruck zu sich selbst. Aber die Zeiten haben sich geandert. Ist sie noch lustig?Der Film begleitet Jeniffer Morland aka die "Schwarze Heidi" bei ihrem ungewohnlichen Neuanfang. Wir erleben, wie sie zwischen Kuche, Comedybuhne und Familie ihre Texte schreibt, Auftritte vorbereitet, Ruckschlage einsteckt - und uber sich hinauswachst. Wir reisen mit ihr in die Schweiz zu ihrer Mutter, wo sie aufgewachsen ist und als Schwarzes Madchen mit Rassismus konfrontiert war. Auch ihr verstorbener Stiefvater liegt dort begraben. Wir sehen sie im Spinningraum, wo sie sich und ihre Schuler trainiert, und fiebern mit bei ihrem ersten Open Mic, wo sie endlich wieder auf der Buhne lacht - mit und uber sich selbst.Zwischen wirtschaftlichem Druck und kunstlerischem Aufbruch erzahlt der Film von einer Frau, die keine perfekte Heldin ist - aber eine echte. Und die sich nicht weniger vorgenommen hat, als nachstes Jahr mit den besten Comedians Deutschlands auf einer Buhne zu stehen. Gelingt ihr das groSSe Comeback?Ein Film uber Lachen, Schmerz und Neuanfang. Und den Mut, noch einmal bei null anzufangen - mitten im Leben.

programme.title: Helge Schneider - The Klimperclown
programme.desc: Helge Schneider, who describes himself as a "link between jazz and nonsense" and has been known to the wide audience since his song "Katzeklo", returns to the screen with this self -portrait. The result is less a classic documentary than a colorful film adventure. The film is a kind of mockumentary that plays with elements of the classic documentary and skillfully changes between truth and fiction. In addition to bizarre sketches, however, the camera, which is played by his guitarist Sandro Giampietro, also offers the viewer deep insights into Helge Schneider's life and work. The film connects the present with various stations of his career. Music plays an important role in this. A colorful round of live performances and specially produced clips alternate with short, sometimes also bizarre statements by the artist. In contrast to the biopics, there are no talking heads that praise the artist. The mixture of the artist's many actors alone impresses and offers an overall picture that cannot be avoided. "Helge Schneider - The Trimperclown" is a film about an unconventional artist - personal, Schrag and all of Helge. / Helge Schneider, der sich selbst als "Bindeglied zwischen Jazz und Quatsch" bezeichnet und dem breiten Publikum spatestens seit seinem Lied "Katzeklo" bekannt ist, kehrt mit diesem Selbstportrait auf die Leinwand zuruck. Entstanden ist weniger eine klassische Doku als ein buntes Filmabenteuer. Der Film ist eine Art Mockumentary, die mit Elementen der klassischen Doku spielt und gekonnt zwischen Wahrheit und Fiktion changiert. Neben skurrilen Sketchen bietet die von seinem Gitarristen Sandro Giampietro gefuhrte Kamera dem Zuschauer jedoch auch tiefe Einblicke in Helge Schneiders Leben und Werk. Der Film verbindet dabei die Gegenwart mit verschiedenen Stationen seiner Karriere. Musik spielt dabei eine wesentliche Rolle. Ein bunter Reigen von Live-Auftritten und eigens fur diesen Film produzierten Clips wechseln ab mit kurzen, teils auch skurrilen Statements des Kunstlers. Im Gegensatz zu ublichen Biopics tauchen keine Talking Heads auf, die den Kunstler loben. Die Mischung der vielen Tatigkeiten des Kunstlers allein besticht und bietet ein Gesamtbild, dem man sich nicht entziehen kann. "Helge Schneider - The Klimperclown" ist ein Film uber einen unkonventionellen Kunstler - personlich, schrag und ganz Helge.

programme.title: Commissario Laurenti - the dead from the Karst / Commissario Laurenti - Die Toten vom Karst
programme.desc: The Triester Commissario Laurenti (Henry Hubchen) is in a private crisis: his wife Laura (Barbara Rudnik), he suspects, has a lover with whom she apparently spent a romantic week by the sea; His son Marco (Sergej Moya) goes on the street with a left -wing group on every occasion against the "brutal police state". In this situation, Laurenti is confronted with a murder case that was confused: During a night bomb attack on her house, the delicatessen Manlio Gubian and his pregnant wife are killed. There does not seem to be a motif for the precisely planned bloody deed. Antonio Gubian (Gotz George), the father of the murdered, also has no explanation for the attack. Commissario Laurenti stands in front of a council. At the same time, a man of her crew over on board and drowns on the high seas goes to a mysterious night-and-fog campaign by the old fisherman Ugo Marasi (Hermann Beyer) and his daughter Nicoletta (Anne Bennent). When the old Marasi is brutally murdered shortly afterwards, there seems to be no connection with the Gubian case. However, after Marasis widow Bruna (Hannelore Hoger) has publicly referred to the old Gubian as the murder of her husband, the puzzle parts are always compiled for Commissario Laurenti: the Croatian Gubian and the Marasi family have connected an ancient hoston since Gubian was supposed to be responsible for the murder of Marasi's sister. At the same time, however, Laurenti finds out that the opaque Nicoletta Marasi smuggled with the Gubian living in his homeland despite this hostility over the sea path cocaine and used her father as a middle man. Did she know about the murder planning? It almost seems when there is a new, dark secret of the two uncolently connected families behind every corner. Now it is to Laurenti to disguise the thread of this braid of drug trafficking and family gang, love and blood revenge ... / Der Triester Commissario Laurenti (Henry Hubchen) steckt in einer privaten Krise: Seine Frau Laura (Barbara Rudnik), so vermutet er, hat einen Liebhaber, mit dem sie offenbar eine romantische Woche am Meer verlebt; sein Sohn Marco (Sergej Moya) geht mit einer linken Gruppierung bei jeder Gelegenheit gegen den "brutalen Polizeistaat" auf die StraSSe. In dieser Situation wird Laurenti mit einem uberaus vertrackten Mordfall konfrontiert: Bei einem nachtlichen Bombenanschlag auf ihr Haus kommen der Feinkosthandler Manlio Gubian und dessen schwangere Ehefrau ums Leben. Ein Motiv fur die genau geplante Bluttat scheint es nicht zu geben. Auch Antonio Gubian (Gotz George), der Vater des Ermordeten, hat keine Erklarung fur das Attentat. Commissario Laurenti steht vor einem Ratsel. Zur gleichen Zeit geht bei einer mysteriosen Nacht-und-Nebel-Aktion des alten Fischers Ugo Marasi (Hermann Beyer) und dessen Tochter Nicoletta (Anne Bennent) auf hoher See ein Mann ihrer Besatzung uber Bord und ertrinkt. Als kurz darauf der alte Marasi brutal ermordet aufgefunden wird, scheint es zunachst keinen Zusammenhang mit dem Fall Gubian zu geben. Nachdem jedoch Marasis Witwe Bruna (Hannelore Hoger) den alten Gubian offentlich als Morder ihres Mannes bezeichnet, setzen sich fur Commissario Laurenti die Puzzle-Teile allmahlich zusammen: Den Kroaten Gubian und die Marasi-Familie verbindet eine uralte Feindschaft, seit Gubian vor vielen Jahren angeblich fur die Ermordung von Marasis Schwester verantwortlich war. Zugleich aber findet Laurenti heraus, dass die undurchsichtige Nicoletta Marasi mit dem in seiner Heimat lebenden Gubian trotz dieser Feindschaft uber den Seeweg Kokain schmuggelt und ihren Vater dabei als Mittelsmann benutzte. Wusste sie womoglich von den Mordplanen? Fast scheint es, als kame hinter jeder Ecke ein neues, dunkles Geheimnis der beiden unheilvoll verbundenen Familien zum Vorschein. Nun ist es an Laurenti, die Faden dieses Geflechts aus Drogenhandel und Familienbande, Liebe und Blutrache zu entwirren ...

programme.title: Hubert und Staller
programme.desc: The ten -year -old Maxi tries to steal backpack again at the Munsingen football field. When Hubert and Staller arrive, you have a bizarre sight: some players of the e-youth suddenly start hallucinating on the football field. Trainer Schrober runs on the nearby country road as if in the delusion and will be transferred. Maxi's arrest is immediately forgotten. Hubert and Staller get around the confused children: were drugs or alcohol involved? Forensic doctor Dr. Caroline Fuchs cannot confirm this, rather she suspects food poisoning. The children indicate that they have had lunch together at the Italian before training. Hubert and Staller make the guest attitudes close. Host Fabrizio Dangelo and his wife Lucia are horrified! They assert that they have nothing to do. In addition, you can expect a lot of customers for the game of two youth teams next weekend. Police Council Girwidz is also going to clarify the case. As the new patron of SV Munsing, he also has a lot of things about a smooth running of the coming match day. The operator's innocence seems to confirm a first check -up of the restaurant. But then Dr. Fuchs in the stomach of the dead trainer traces of a toxic mushroom oxin. This cannot be a coincidence! While Riedl is allowed to pretend with the little backpack thief, Staller dares to take a selfless test: to find out quickly and unurocratically how and when the poison came into the food, he orders all meals in the restaurant that had taken the poisoned players ... / Der zehnjahrige Maxi versucht, am Munsinger FuSSballplatz mal wieder Rucksacke zu klauen. Als Hubert und Staller eintreffen, bietet sich ihnen ein bizarrer Anblick: Einige Spieler der E-Jugend fangen auf dem FuSSballfeld plotzlich an zu halluzinieren. Trainer Schrober rennt wie im Wahn auf die nahegelegene LandstraSSe und wird uberfahren. Maxis Festnahme ist augenblicklich vergessen. Hubert und Staller kummern sich um die verwirrten Kinder: Waren Drogen oder Alkohol im Spiel? Gerichtsmedizinerin Dr. Caroline Fuchs kann das nicht bestatigen, sie vermutet vielmehr eine Lebensmittelvergiftung.Die Kinder geben an, vor dem Training gemeinsam beim Italiener neben dem Bolzplatz zu Mittag gegessen zu haben. Hubert und Staller lassen die Gaststatte unverzuglich schlieSSen. Wirt Fabrizio DAngelo und seine Frau Lucia sind entsetzt! Sie beteuern, damit nichts zu tun zu haben. AuSSerdem erwarten sie fur das Spiel zweier Jugendmannschaften am kommenden Wochenende viel Kundschaft. Auch Polizeirat Girwidz drangt auf eine schnelle Klarung des Falls. Als neuer Schirmherr des SV Munsing liegt ihm ebenfalls viel an einem reibungslosen Ablauf des kommenden Spieltags. Eine erste Überprufung des Lokals scheint die Unschuld der Betreiber zu bestatigen. Doch dann entdeckt Dr. Fuchs im Magen des toten Trainers Spuren eines Fliegenpilztoxins. Das kann kein Zufall sein!Wahrend Riedl sich mit dem kleinen Rucksackdieb herumargern darf, wagt Staller einen selbstlosen Test: Um schnell und unburokratisch herauszufinden, wie und wann das Gift ins Essen gekommen ist, bestellt er im Lokal alle Mahlzeiten, die die vergifteten Spieler zu sich genommen hatten ...

programme.desc: Hubert and Staller have a Ubler sight: The competing pig farmers Ferdinand Mayer and Josef Schmidl have a lot of Zoff. When Hubert wants to intervene, Staller suddenly collapses. In the hospital then the serious diagnosis: if he does not get the raised cholesterol values under control by changing the detection, he threatens heart attack, stroke and death. Staller falls into a deep crisis of meaning and questions his whole life. Schweinbauer Josef Schmidl is murdered. The suspicion quickly falls on Schmidl's son, who was seen as he was smeared in blood smear and drunk over the streets. But the blood does not come from his father, but from Ferdinand Mayer's best breeding. It turns out that the boy stabbed her out of revenge because Mayer had sparkled his father, but soon Gerat also suspected of suspicion: Hubert finds that she has an affara with an asset advisor Jan Kurtzmann. Of all things! Because this saves Staller's life in the form of cooking courses. Nevertheless, he feels Kurtzmann on the tooth during one of his cooking hours. At the same time, forensic doctor Caroline Fuchs can finally determine the murder instrument: a pan! Hubert initiates an investigation by Kurtzmann's pans and actually, one of them is the murder weapon. The detention advisor denies having committed the murder. Hubert and Staller are skeptical, but then the leaf turns and they come to a huge scandal. The dead sow from Bauer Mayer of all people contributes to the slogan of the case. / Hubert und Staller bietet sich ein ubler Anblick: Die konkurrierenden Schweinebauern Ferdinand Mayer und Josef Schmidl haben heftig Zoff. Als Hubert eingreifen will, bricht Staller ganz plotzlich zusammen. Im Krankenhaus dann die ernuchternde Diagnose: Wenn er die erhohten Cholesterinwerte nicht durch Ernahrungsumstellung in den Griff bekommt, drohen ihm Herzinfarkt, Schlaganfall und Tod. Staller sturzt in eine tiefe Sinnkrise und stellt sein ganzes Leben in Frage. Da wird Schweinebauer Josef Schmidl ermordet. Der Verdacht fallt schnell auf Schmidls Sohn, der dabei gesehen wurde, wie er blutverschmiert und betrunken uber die StraSSen irrte. Doch das Blut stammt nicht von seinem Vater, sondern von Ferdinand Mayers bester Zuchtsau. Es stellt sich heraus, dass der Junge sie aus Rache abgestochen hat, weil Mayer seinen Vater verhauen hatte.Doch bald gerat auch Schmidls Ehefrau unter Verdacht: Hubert findet heraus, dass sie eine Affare mit Ernahrungsberater Jan Kurtzmann hat. Ausgerechnet! Denn dieser rettet gerade Stallers Leben in Form von Kochkursen. Trotzdem fuhlt er Kurtzmann bei einer seiner Kochstunden auf den Zahn.Gleichzeitig kann Gerichtsmedizinerin Caroline Fuchs endlich das Mordinstrument ermitteln: eine Pfanne! Hubert veranlasst eine Untersuchung von Kurtzmanns Pfannen und tatsachlich, eine davon ist die Tatwaffe. Der Ernahrungsberater leugnet, den Mord begangen zu haben. Hubert und Staller sind skeptisch, doch dann wendet sich das Blatt und sie kommen einem riesigen Skandal auf die Schliche. Ausgerechnet die tote Sau von Bauer Mayer tragt zur Losung des Falls bei.

An den Spitzen der Parlamentsparteien hat es zahlreiche Rollenwechsel gegeben. NEOS-Vorsitzende Beate Meinl-Reisinger hat ihre Partei erstmals in eine Bundesregierung gefuhrt und ist seit Marz Bundesministerin fur europaische und internationale Angelegenheiten.Wie erlebt sie personlich den Wechsel von der angriffigen Oppositionspolitikerin an die Spitze der heimischen Diplomatie? programme.title: Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Niederosterreich
programme.sub-title: A country as aquipment - the Babenberger and her Austria / Ein Land als Vermachtnis - die Babenberger und ihr Österreich
programme.desc: The Babenberger rule Austria from 976 to 1246. In its almost 300-year reign, Austria wakes up. The film from the ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich is broadcast as a repetition (December 2024) (design: Sabine Daxberger, camera: Philipp Wied, Helmut Muttenthaler) is a search for traces in the original shot in Niederosterreich, where its rule begins. From pens and castles to art offs, using the example of rulers such as Markgraf Leopold III, the saint, the duke Leopold V., Leopold VI. Or women like margrave Agnes. The cinematic journey goes far into the world of the Middle Ages, for example to the Gars Castle on Kamp, in which the later Markgraf Leopold III, the saint, weaks up. But also treasures from Agnes and Leopold's lifetime, such as a mysterious veil that is attributed to Agnes or a seven -arm bronze light. A treasure in the pen is also the medieval copy of the "Privilege Minus", that certificate, with which Stauferkaiser Friedrich Barbarossa Austria raised Austria in 1256. The Babenberger family tree, which was only commissioned only in the 15th century, is unique after the canonization Leopold III. In 1485. The film questions the ruler behind the picture - a clever strategist who brings Austria peace and stabilitation. He informs Emperor Henry IV before a battle and catapults the Babenberger into the highest imperial nobility through marriage to the emperor's daughter Agnes. From then on, his descendants are related to the salier and stowers. What is the Capuchin crypt for the Habsburg, is the Heiligenkreuz Abbey for the Babenberger. It is their greatest burial. The documentary also researches secrets such as an ancient heating chamber or the booker list of the first abbot from the time of the foundation of the pen, the Lepold III. 1133 Based on 192, Styria falls to Leopold V, known as the kidnapper of England's King Richard Lowenherz. His son, Duke Leopold VI. The film sprints the remains of this disappeared medieval chapel. The Lilienfeld collegiate church is Leopold VI's life's work. He is buried there, next to his daughter Margarete, a two -time configuration.1246 the Babenberg rule ends with the death of the childless Duke Friedrich II in the Battle of the Leitha. His heiress and sister Margarete marries Bohmens Konig Ottokar in Hainburg, who then separates from her. The film goes into the colorful and exciting world of the Babenberg rulers who build Austria and bring prosperity, culture and stabilization. / Die Babenberger regieren von 976 bis 1246 Österreich. In ihrer fast 300- jahrigen Regentschaft wachst Österreich und bluht auf. Der Film aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich wird als Wiederholung (Dezember 2024) ausgestrahlt (Gestaltung: Sabine Daxberger, Kamera: Philipp Wied, Helmut Muttenthaler) ist eine Spurensuche an Originalschauplatzen in Niederosterreich, wo ihre Herrschaft beginnt. Von Stiften und Burgen bis hin zu Kunstschatzen, am Beispiel von Herrschern wie Markgraf Leopold III, dem Heiligen, den Herzogen Leopold V., Leopold VI. oder Frauen wie Markgrafin Agnes. Die filmische Reise fuhrt weit zuruck in die Welt des Mittelalters, etwa in die Burg Gars am Kamp, in der der spatere Markgraf Leopold III, der Heilige, groSSteils aufwachst.Die Doku besucht Stift Klosterneuburg, das der Heilige Leopold 1114 grundet, zeigt seine dortige Grabstatte und seine prachtig geschmuckte Schadelreliquie. Aber auch Kostbarkeiten aus Agnes und Leopolds Lebenszeit, wie einen geheimnisvollen Schleier, der Agnes zugeschrieben wird oder einen siebenarmigen Bronzeleuchter. Ein Schatz im Stift ist auch die mittelalterliche Abschrift des "Privilegium Minus", jener Urkunde, mit der Stauferkaiser Friedrich Barbarossa Österreich 1256 zum Herzogtum erhebt. Einzigartig ist auch der Babenberger Stammbaum, der erst im 15. Jahrhundert in Auftrag gegeben wird, nach der Heiligsprechung Leopold III. im Jahr 1485.Der Film hinterfragt den Herrscher hinter dem Heiligenbild - ein kluger Stratege, der Österreich Frieden und Stabilitat bringt. Er kundigt Kaiser Heinrich IV. vor einer Schlacht die Treue auf und katapultiert durch die Heirat mit der Kaisertochter Agnes die Babenberger in den hochsten Reichsadel. Seine Nachkommen sind fortan mit den Salier- und Stauferkaisern verwandt.Was die Kapuzinergruft fur die Habsburger ist, ist Stift Heiligenkreuz fur die Babenberger. Es ist ihre groSSte Grablege. Die Doku erforscht aber auch Geheimnisse wie eine uralte Heizkammer oder die Bucherliste des ersten Abtes aus der Entstehungszeit des Stiftes, das Lepold III. 1133 grundet.1192 fallt die Steiermark an Leopold V., bekannt als Kidnapper von Englands Konig Richard Lowenherz. Sein Sohn, Herzog Leopold VI., bringt die Gotik nach Österreich, etwa mit der legendaren "Capella Speciosa" in Klosterneuburg. Die Reste dieser verschwundenen mittelalterlichen Kapelle spurt der Film auf. Die Stiftskirche von Lilienfeld ist das Lebenswerk von Leopold VI. Er liegt dort begraben, neben seiner Tochter Margarete, einer zweifachen Konigin.1246 endet die Babenberger Herrschaft mit dem Tod des kinderlosen Herzog Friedrich II. in der Schlacht an der Leitha. Seine Erbin und Schwester Margarete heiratet in Hainburg Bohmens Konig Ottokar, der sich dann von ihr trennt. Der Film entfuhrt in die bunte und spannende Welt der Babenberger Herrscher, die Österreich aufbauen und Wohlstand, Kultur und Stabilitat bringen.

programme.title: Am Schauplatz
programme.sub-title: Masterpiece - of the joy of handicrafts / Meisterwerk - von der Freude an der Handarbeit
programme.desc: Most objects that surround us in everyday life are industrially manufactured. Manual work is expensive in almost every context and you try to avoid them. At the same time, an increasing number of young people discovered working with their hand and learning craftsmanship as a source of Gluck and Satisfaction. 18 years ago, at the scene reporter Robert Gordon, the apprentice of shoemakers Georg Maier met in the workshop of his master in Lower Easter Empire. The young man hadn't been happily with the school, but how to make shoes was interested, and he still finds it exciting. Uben to uben over a thousands of hours does not have a deterrent to people like Georg Maier. Experience yourself as competent every time a master's stucco often pays more than a high income. For many people, this kind of satisfaction is hard to achieve in their everyday work. Passionate craftsmen are even willing to do without collateral that have already been achieved. Bernhard Dellinger, a graduate engineer and young family man, has found a youth wish and gave up his well-paid job in industry. He wants to become a self -made carpenter. Just like the former web designer Marie, with whom he will compete in autumn. Art and craft the violin builders Kerstin Hoffmann and Claudia Rook combine, who build their instruments in a common workshop and the glassmaker Robert Comploj.fur visits Robert Gordon different workshops and tries to achieve the fascination of craft. / Die meisten Gegenstande, die uns im Alltag umgeben, sind industriell gefertigt. Handarbeit ist in fast jedem Zusammenhang teuer und man versucht sie zu vermeiden. Zugleich entdeckt eine zunehmende Anzahl junger Menschen die Arbeit mit der Hand und das Erlernen handwerklicher Kompetenzen als Quelle von Gluck und Zufriedenheit.Vor 18 Jahren hat Am Schauplatz-Reporter Robert Gordon den Schuhmacherlehrling Georg Maier in der Werkstatt seines Meisters in Niederosterreich kennen gelernt. Mit der Schule war der junge Mann nicht glucklich gewesen, aber wie man Schuhe macht, das hat ihn interessiert, und er findet das immer noch spannend. Über tausendende Stunden Handgriffe zu uben, wirkt fur Menschen wie Georg Maier nicht abschreckend. Sich selbst jedes Mal wieder als kompetent zu erleben, wenn ein Meisterstuck fertig ist, zahlt oft mehr als ein hohes Einkommen.Fur viele Menschen ist diese Art Befriedigung in ihrem Arbeitsalltag kaum zu erreichen. Dafur sind leidenschaftliche Handwerker sogar bereit, auf bereits erreichte Sicherheiten zu verzichten. Bernhard Dellinger, Diplomingenieur und junger Familienvater, hat sich einen Jugend-Wunsch erfullt und seinen gut bezahlten Job in der Industrie aufgegeben. Er will selbstandiger Tischlermeister werden. So wie die ehemalige Webdesignerin Marie, mit der er im Herbst zur Meisterprufung antreten wird.Kunst und Handwerk vereinen die Geigenbauerinnen Kerstin Hoffmann und Claudia Rook, die ihre Instrumente in einer gemeinsamen Werkstatt bauen und der Glasmacher Robert Comploj.Fur seine aktuelle Reportage besucht Robert Gordon unterschiedliche Werkstatten und versucht die Faszination Handwerk zu ergrunden.

programme.title: Philosophisches Forum
programme.sub-title: Artificial intelligence: better than humans? / Kunstliche Intelligenz: besser als der Mensch?
programme.desc: A race for the latest development of artificial intelligence (AI) broke out in the digital world. programme.title: Summer discussion 2025 / Sommergesprache 2025
programme.sub-title: Klaus Webhofer in a conversation with Beate Meinl-Reisinger, Neos / Klaus Webhofer im Gesprach mit Beate Meinl-Reisinger, NEOS
programme.desc: Domestic policy chief Klaus Webhofer for the first time leads through the interview series. The "Summer Talks 25" with the chairpersons of the parliament represented in the parliament can be seen this year from August 11th to September 8th, every Monday, at 9:00 p.m. in ORF 2 and on ORF ON. The setting has been the ORF media campus on Kuniglberg for the first time since 2022. Austria's domestic landscape has changed significantly this year. There have been numerous roles at the top of the parliamentary parties. NEOS chairwoman Beate Meinl-Reisinger has taken her party to a federal government for the first time and has been Federal Minister for European and international affairs since Marz. Can it form the NEOS into a relevant government party and often implement the reforms required? / Innenpolitik-Chef Klaus Webhofer fuhrt erstmals durch die Interview-Reihe. Die "Sommergesprache 25" mit den Vorsitzenden der im Parlament vertretenen Fraktionen sind heuer vom 11. August bis zum 8. September, immer montags, um 21.00 Uhr in ORF 2 und auf ORF ON zu sehen. Schauplatz ist erstmals seit 2022 wieder der ORF-Mediencampus am Kuniglberg.Österreichs innenpolitische Landschaft hat sich in diesem Jahr stark verandert. An den Spitzen der Parlamentsparteien hat es zahlreiche Rollenwechsel gegeben. NEOS-Vorsitzende Beate Meinl-Reisinger hat ihre Partei erstmals in eine Bundesregierung gefuhrt und ist seit Marz Bundesministerin fur europaische und internationale Angelegenheiten.Wie erlebt sie personlich den Wechsel von der angriffigen Oppositionspolitikerin an die Spitze der heimischen Diplomatie? Kann sie die NEOS zu einer verlasslichen Regierungspartei formen und oft geforderte Reformen umsetzen?
