programme.sub-title: A country as aquipment - the Babenberger and her Austria / Ein Land als Vermachtnis - die Babenberger und ihr Österreich
programme.desc: The Babenberger rule Austria from 976 to 1246. In its almost 300-year reign, Austria wakes up. The film from the ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich is broadcast as a repetition (December 2024) (design: Sabine Daxberger, camera: Philipp Wied, Helmut Muttenthaler) is a search for traces in the original shot in Niederosterreich, where its rule begins. From pens and castles to art offs, using the example of rulers such as Markgraf Leopold III, the saint, the duke Leopold V., Leopold VI. Or women like margrave Agnes. The cinematic journey goes far into the world of the Middle Ages, for example to the Gars Castle on Kamp, in which the later Markgraf Leopold III, the saint, weaks up. But also treasures from Agnes and Leopold's lifetime, such as a mysterious veil that is attributed to Agnes or a seven -arm bronze light. A treasure in the pen is also the medieval copy of the "Privilege Minus", that certificate, with which Stauferkaiser Friedrich Barbarossa Austria raised Austria in 1256. The Babenberger family tree, which was only commissioned only in the 15th century, is unique after the canonization Leopold III. In 1485. The film questions the ruler behind the picture - a clever strategist who brings Austria peace and stabilitation. He informs Emperor Henry IV before a battle and catapults the Babenberger into the highest imperial nobility through marriage to the emperor's daughter Agnes. From then on, his descendants are related to the salier and stowers. What is the Capuchin crypt for the Habsburg, is the Heiligenkreuz Abbey for the Babenberger. It is their greatest burial. The documentary also researches secrets such as an ancient heating chamber or the booker list of the first abbot from the time of the foundation of the pen, the Lepold III. 1133 Based on 192, Styria falls to Leopold V, known as the kidnapper of England's King Richard Lowenherz. His son, Duke Leopold VI. The film sprints the remains of this disappeared medieval chapel. The Lilienfeld collegiate church is Leopold VI's life's work. He is buried there, next to his daughter Margarete, a two -time configuration.1246 the Babenberg rule ends with the death of the childless Duke Friedrich II in the Battle of the Leitha. His heiress and sister Margarete marries Bohmens Konig Ottokar in Hainburg, who then separates from her. The film goes into the colorful and exciting world of the Babenberg rulers who build Austria and bring prosperity, culture and stabilization. / Die Babenberger regieren von 976 bis 1246 Österreich. In ihrer fast 300- jahrigen Regentschaft wachst Österreich und bluht auf. Der Film aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich wird als Wiederholung (Dezember 2024) ausgestrahlt (Gestaltung: Sabine Daxberger, Kamera: Philipp Wied, Helmut Muttenthaler) ist eine Spurensuche an Originalschauplatzen in Niederosterreich, wo ihre Herrschaft beginnt. Von Stiften und Burgen bis hin zu Kunstschatzen, am Beispiel von Herrschern wie Markgraf Leopold III, dem Heiligen, den Herzogen Leopold V., Leopold VI. oder Frauen wie Markgrafin Agnes. Die filmische Reise fuhrt weit zuruck in die Welt des Mittelalters, etwa in die Burg Gars am Kamp, in der der spatere Markgraf Leopold III, der Heilige, groSSteils aufwachst.Die Doku besucht Stift Klosterneuburg, das der Heilige Leopold 1114 grundet, zeigt seine dortige Grabstatte und seine prachtig geschmuckte Schadelreliquie. Aber auch Kostbarkeiten aus Agnes und Leopolds Lebenszeit, wie einen geheimnisvollen Schleier, der Agnes zugeschrieben wird oder einen siebenarmigen Bronzeleuchter. Ein Schatz im Stift ist auch die mittelalterliche Abschrift des "Privilegium Minus", jener Urkunde, mit der Stauferkaiser Friedrich Barbarossa Österreich 1256 zum Herzogtum erhebt. Einzigartig ist auch der Babenberger Stammbaum, der erst im 15. Jahrhundert in Auftrag gegeben wird, nach der Heiligsprechung Leopold III. im Jahr 1485.Der Film hinterfragt den Herrscher hinter dem Heiligenbild - ein kluger Stratege, der Österreich Frieden und Stabilitat bringt. Er kundigt Kaiser Heinrich IV. vor einer Schlacht die Treue auf und katapultiert durch die Heirat mit der Kaisertochter Agnes die Babenberger in den hochsten Reichsadel. Seine Nachkommen sind fortan mit den Salier- und Stauferkaisern verwandt.Was die Kapuzinergruft fur die Habsburger ist, ist Stift Heiligenkreuz fur die Babenberger. Es ist ihre groSSte Grablege. Die Doku erforscht aber auch Geheimnisse wie eine uralte Heizkammer oder die Bucherliste des ersten Abtes aus der Entstehungszeit des Stiftes, das Lepold III. 1133 grundet.1192 fallt die Steiermark an Leopold V., bekannt als Kidnapper von Englands Konig Richard Lowenherz. Sein Sohn, Herzog Leopold VI., bringt die Gotik nach Österreich, etwa mit der legendaren "Capella Speciosa" in Klosterneuburg. Die Reste dieser verschwundenen mittelalterlichen Kapelle spurt der Film auf. Die Stiftskirche von Lilienfeld ist das Lebenswerk von Leopold VI. Er liegt dort begraben, neben seiner Tochter Margarete, einer zweifachen Konigin.1246 endet die Babenberger Herrschaft mit dem Tod des kinderlosen Herzog Friedrich II. in der Schlacht an der Leitha. Seine Erbin und Schwester Margarete heiratet in Hainburg Bohmens Konig Ottokar, der sich dann von ihr trennt. programme.title: Austria - the whole story / Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte
programme.desc: The late summer in 1683 was dug up as a deep scar in the history of Vienna. Not much was missing, and the imperial city had been succumbing to the urge to expand of the Ottomans. Follow nine of the new ORF III series "Austria - The whole story" is devoted to these dramatic days. The documentation also reveals what happened all around in the relationship between Austria and the Orient. Because both before and afterwards there was a lively exchange between west and east, and the fascination for the Ottoman lifestyle was at least as great as the fear of its urge to expand. Turkish culture has left its visible traces in the Esterreiche way of life. From coffee over the Kipferl to the apple strudel, a lot can only be explained by the penetration of the western and eastern worlds. Directed by Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev / Der Spatsommer 1683 hat sich als tiefe Narbe in die Geschichte Wiens eingegraben. Viel hatte nicht gefehlt, und die Kaiserstadt ware dem Expansionsdrang der Osmanen erlegen. Folge neun der neuen ORF III-Serie "Österreich - die ganze Geschichte" widmet sich diesen dramatischen Tagen. Die Dokumentation erzahlt aber auch, was rundherum im Verhaltnis zwischen Österreich und dem Orient passierte. Denn sowohl davor als auch danach gab es einen regen Austausch zwischen West und Ost, und die Faszination fur die osmanische Lebensweise war mindestens so groSS wie die Furcht vor ihrem Expansionsdrang. Die turkische Kultur hat ihre sichtbaren Spuren in der osterreichischen Lebensweise hinterlassen. Vom Kaffee uber das Kipferl bis zum Apfelstrudel ist Vieles nur durch die Durchdringung der westlichen und der ostlichen Lebenswelten erklarbar. Regie: Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev

programme.title: Austria - the whole story / Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte
programme.desc: When Franz Hebenstreit goes to the gallows after the Vienna "Jakobin process", the idea for which he will die was just born. The Kaiserhaus defends itself against the idea that the people should take power against the idea. On the contrary - with reforms Maria Theresia and Joseph II are consolidated by the monarchy, which from then on in Austria still maintained one and a half centuries. Andreas Pfeifer and Mariella Gittler go to the cradle of our political system in a row ten of "Austria - The whole History", supports of comprehensive game scenes and tell the dramatic struggle. It took a long time for this fight to be dined out of the republic. Directed by Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev / Als Franz Hebenstreit nach dem Wiener "Jakobinerprozess" zum Galgen schreitet, ist die Idee, fur die er sterben wird, gerade erst geboren. Mit aller Kraft wehrt sich das Kaiserhaus gegen die Vorstellung, dass das Volk die Macht ubernehmen sollte. Im Gegenteil - mit Reformen festigen Maria Theresia und Joseph II. die Monarchie, die von da ab in Österreich noch eineinhalb Jahrhunderte wahrte. Andreas Pfeifer und Mariella Gittler gehen in Folge zehn von "Österreich - die ganze Geschichte", unterstutzt von umfassenden Spielszenen, an die Wiege unseres heutigen politischen Systems und erzahlen das dramatische Ringen darum. Bis dieser Kampf in die Ausrufung der Republik mundete, dauerte es noch lange. Regie: Maximilian Traxl, Philip Aleksiev

programme.desc: We breathe up in the wild and well. We are hardly aware that this "free" nature is a federally. programme.title: Austria - the whole story / Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte
programme.desc: The parliament is considered a heart of the Esterreich Democracy. Its beginnings are enough in 1848 when it comes together for the first time under the name "Constituent Reichstag". The wave of revolution of this year not only founds our parliamentarianism, it also frees the Easter -Reician farmers from the rule of land. From then on, the state grief about a lot that has so far been about the landlords. This creates the Esterreichische civil servant army and the modern administrative state, as we still know it today. The moving history of the unconventional revolutionary parche Alfred Becher and Karoline von Perin forms the red thread through this episode. The Habsburg monarchy had already been released, revolts and struggles, but in this revolution the self -confident burger, the vacuumed workers and national forces are associated with a concentrated front against the imperial house. The Habsburgers realize that this time it is about everything. R: Christian Papke, moderation: Andreas Pfeifer and Mariella Gittler / Das Parlament gilt als Herzstuck der osterreichischen Demokratie. Seine Anfange reichen in das Jahr 1848 zuruck, als es erstmals unter dem Namen "Constituierender Reichstag" zusammentritt. Die Revolutionswelle dieses Jahres begrundet nicht nur unseren Parlamentarismus, sie befreit auch die osterreichischen Bauern von der Grundherrschaft. Ab da kummert sich der Staat um vieles, was bisher uber die Grundherren gelaufen ist. Daraus entstehen das osterreichische Beamtenheer und der moderne Verwaltungsstaat, wie wir ihn heute noch kennen. Die bewegende Geschichte des unkonventionellen Revolutionsparchens Alfred Becher und Karoline von Perin bildet den roten Faden durch diese Folge. Aufstande, Revolten und Kampfe hatte die Habsburgermonarchie auch schon fruher uberwunden, doch in dieser Revolution verbunden sich das selbstbewusste Burgertum, die unterdruckten Arbeiter sowie nationale Krafte zu einer geballten Front gegen das Kaiserhaus. Den Habsburgern wird klar, dass es diesmal um alles geht. R: Christian Papke, Moderation: Andreas Pfeifer und Mariella Gittler

programme.title: Sportlegenden - Hans Orsolics
programme.desc: ORF III production shows the life legend Hans Orsolics: Boxer, Sanger, cult figure, which is even more deep. "A rage and rabade from childhood" he is said to have been. Growing up in Ottakring, his "mother tongue is not German, but Viennese". In June 1967, Hans Orsolics wrote boxing history: In the fight for the European championship title of the European Box Union (EBU) in the semi -world weight, he won against the German Conny Rudhof in the Vienna Stadthalle. At almost 20 years, he was the youngest European title carrier until then. A European championship title followed. An unnecessary knockout Defeat in a preparatory fight against the American ex-world champion Eddie Perkins then brought the emerging boxer out of step completely. Further defeats followed. Despite his enormous popularity and his undeniable boxing talent, his athlete career ended at the age of 28. Misors and its increasing alcohol slope drove to his unprecedented social descent. Orsolics, meanwhile bite owners, could be involved in inensity and spent a total of 846 days in prison. The turn in 1985 brought an ORF documentary, in which Orsolic's great successes of his dreary situation were prepared. A wave of helpfulness followed and the Viennese songwriter Charly Kriechbaum wrote Orsolics the hit "Mei Potscherte's Life", which catapulted orsolics at the top of the charts. "Even if he had to take a lot of personal defeats, Hans Orsolics lives back and satisfied today," said his long -year -old friend Sigi Bergmann. Director Robert Altenburger traces the history of the most successful Austria boxer to date, whose big talent was unfortunately mostly covered by negative headlines. / Die ORF III-Produktion zeigt das von Hohen und noch mehr Tiefen gepragte Leben der Boxlegende Hans Orsolics: Boxer, Sanger, Kultfigur. "Ein Raufer und Rabauke von Kindesbeinen an" soll er gewesen sein. Aufgewachsen in Ottakring ist seine "Muttersprache nicht Deutsch, sondern Wienerisch". Im Juni 1967 schrieb Hans Orsolics Boxgeschichte: Im Kampf um den Europameistertitel der Europaischen Box Union (EBU) im Halbweltergewicht siegte er in der Wiener Stadthalle gegen den Deutschen Conny Rudhof. Mit knapp 20 Jahren war er der bis dahin jungste europaische Titeltrager. Ein Europameistertitel im Weltergewicht folgte. Eine unnotige k.o. Niederlage in einem Vorbereitungskampf gegen den US-amerikanischen Ex-Weltmeister Eddie Perkins brachte den aufstrebenden Boxer dann jedoch vollig aus dem Tritt. Weitere Niederlagen folgten. Trotz seiner enormen Popularitat und seines unbestreitbaren boxerischen Talents endete seine Sportlerkarriere mit nur 28 Jahren. Fehlinvestitionen und seine zunehmende Alkoholabhangigkeit fuhrten zu seinem beispiellosen sozialen Abstieg. Orsolics, mittlerweile Beisl-Besitzer lieSS sich in unzahlige Raufereien verwickeln und verbrachte insgesamt 846 Tage im Gefangnis. Die Wende brachte 1985 eine ORF-Dokumentation, in der Orsolics groSSe Erfolge seiner tristen Situation gegenubergestellt wurden. Eine Welle der Hilfsbereitschaft folgte und der Wiener Liedermacher Charly Kriechbaum schrieb Orsolics den Hit "Mei potschertes Leben" auf den Leib, der Orsolics an die Spitze der Charts katapultierte. "Auch wenn er viele personliche Niederlagen einstecken musste, lebt Hans Orsolics heute zuruckgezogen und zufrieden", so sein langjahriger Freund Sigi Bergmann.Regisseur Robert Altenburger zeichnet in dieser Dokumentation die Geschichte des bis heute erfolgreichsten osterreichischen Boxers nach, dessen groSSes Talent leider meist von negativen Schlagzeilen uberdeckt wurde.

programme.title: Land der Berge
programme.sub-title: Das magische Maggiatal: Klare Bergseen und majestatische Gipfel
programme.desc: Hans Jochler is traveling in the magical Maggiatal in Switzerland in this visual "Land of Mountain" production. The mixture of alpine beautiful and Mediterranean flair makes the Maggiatal a unique background place. The idyllic places, in a wonderful location between mountains and water, have attracted artists since the 20th century. In Ascona, the climatic health resort of Ascona with its inviting lake promenade you can experience the messenger of the spring up close. The impressive "Holy Mountain" Madonna del Sasso, a place of pilgrimage on a rock lead with a breathtaking view over the lake, allows an insight behind its historical and spiritual walls. Apart from the moon banks of the Lago Maggiore, the wild, beautiful Alps reveals itself, which offer a unique setting for small towns such as Bignasco. From historical straw roofers in Onsernone to modern architectural wonders in Mogno - "Land of the Mountains" immerse yourself in the diverse culture and history of the Maggiatal and portrays one of the most beautiful regions in Switzerland. / In dieser bildgewaltigen "Land der Berge"-Produktion ist Hans Jochler im magischen Maggiatal in der Schweiz unterwegs. Die Mischung aus alpiner Schonheit und mediterranem Flair macht das Maggiatal zu einem einzigartigen Ruckzugsort. Die idyllischen Orte, in herrlicher Lage zwischen Bergen und Wasser, ziehen seit dem 20. Jahrhundert Kunstlerinnen und Kunstler an.Im Luftkurort Ascona mit seiner einladenden Seepromenade kann man die Boten des Fruhlings hautnah miterleben. Der beeindruckende "heilige Berg" Madonna del Sasso, ein Wallfahrtsort auf einem Felsvorsprung mit atemberaubendem Blick uber den See, erlaubt Einblicke hinter seine geschichtstrachtigen und spirituellen Mauern. Abseits der mondanen Ufer des Lago Maggiore offenbart sich die wilde Schonheit der Tessiner Alpen, die eine einzigartige Kulisse fur kleine Ortschaften wie Bignasco bieten. Von historischen Strohdachern in Onsernone bis zu modernen Architekturwundern in Mogno - "Land der Berge" taucht ein in die vielfaltige Kultur und Geschichte des Maggiatals und portraitiert eine der schonsten Regionen der Schweiz.

programme.title: Land der Berge
programme.sub-title: Locksmith, lakes and high mountains / Schlosser, Seen und hohe Berge
programme.desc: Kuhn built, on a rock nose in the tranquil Allgau, the stone dream of Ludwig II - the Neuschwanstein Castle. Between illusionist wall paintings, gold -based fabrics and all sorts of objects, each one of which represents a real gem, the lock is decorated with different leitmotifs: the swan as a heraldic animal and a Christian symbol of purity can be found in many corners and angles. Although the Marchenwelt Neuschwanstein was probably able to enchant its visitors for days with their pomp and splendor, the trip continues; Passing the Plansee, which acts like a matt grun mirror for the summit over the bogged summit, to the goal: the Wilde Karwendelgebirge. More than 340 sources arise from the local landscape there - including the Isar, which is probably known to many as a Bavarian, although their origin is in Tyrol. In this "Land of the Mountains" production, the filmmaker Hans Jochler runs through the splendid world of locksmith, residences and estates, without losing the fascinating treasures of nature. / Kuhn errichtet, auf einer Felsnase im beschaulichen Allgau steht der Stein gewordene Traum Konig Ludwigs II. - das Schloss Neuschwanstein. Zwischen illusionistischen Wandmalereien, golddurchwirkten Stoffen und allerlei Gegenstanden, von denen jeder Einzelne ein wahres Kleinod darstellt, ist das Schloss mit verschiedenen Leitmotiven verziert: So ist der Schwan als Wappentier und christliches Symbol der Reinheit in vielen Ecken und Winkeln wiederzufinden. Obgleich die Marchenwelt Neuschwansteins ihre BesucherInnen wohl auch tagelang mit ihrem Pomp und Prunk bezaubern konnte, fuhrt die Reise weiter; vorbei am Plansee, der wie ein mattgruner Spiegel fur die ihn umsaumenden Gipfel wirkt, bis zum Ziel: das wilde Karwendelgebirge. Mehr als 340 Quellen entspringen der dortigen, urtumlichen Landschaft - so auch die Isar, die vielen wohl eher als Bayerin bekannt ist, obgleich ihr Ursprung in Tirol liegt. In dieser "Land der Berge"-Produktion fuhrt der Filmemacher Hans Jochler durch die prachtige Welt der Schlosser, Residenzen und Anwesen, ohne dabei das Staunen fur die faszinierenden Kostbarkeiten der Natur zu verlieren.

programme.title: Austria - the whole story / Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte
programme.sub-title: The fight for the street / Der Kampf um die StraSSe
programme.desc: The car begins as a toy of the rich, a few hundred copies in Vienna at the end of the 19th century. The traffic revolution, which will be dangerous from it, is not in sight at the time. For a while, the automobile appears as the clean slogan against the sprawling horse traffic with its mountains of facalies. Whether with steam, electric or combustion drive, it is still undecided at first. The young Ferdinand Porsche comes to the automotive sector as an electrician, but then turns to the hybrid and soon completely after the petrol engine. At that time, chauffeurs live dangerous - bursting tires, exploding engines and also crooks that climb ropes across the street, belong to the automotive everyday life at the time. Rudolf Hruza, who can be retrained from the coachman to the driver of a well -known rule, will also pay his fascination for the car with life. In the "Austria Texas", in Galicia, the oil demand increases to its maximum. Austria ranks under the big players of global earth gods for a while. A trip to the birth of the car in Austria with Andreas Pfeifer and Mariella Gittler. R: Martin Vogg, Florian Riedelsperger / Das Auto beginnt als Spielzeug der Reichen, wenige hundert Exemplare fahren Ende des 19. Jahrhunderts in Wien herum. Die Verkehrsrevolution, die von diesem Gefahrt einmal ausgehen wird, ist damals noch nicht in Sicht. Eine Zeit lang erscheint das Automobil als die saubere Losung gegen den ausufernden Pferdeverkehr mit seinen Bergen an Fakalien. Ob mit Dampf-, Elektro- oder Verbrenner-Antrieb, ist anfangs noch unentschieden. Der junge Ferdinand Porsche kommt als Elektriker zum Automobilgeschaft, wendet sich dann aber dem Hybrid- und bald darauf ganz dem Benzinmotor zu. Chauffeure leben damals gefahrlich - platzende Reifen, explodierende Motoren und auch Ganoven, die Seile quer uber die StraSSe spannen, gehoren damals zum automobilen Alltag. Auch Rudolf Hruza, der sich vom Kutscher zum Fahrer einer betuchten Herrschaft umschulen lasst, wird seine Faszination fur das Auto mit dem Leben bezahlen. Im "osterreichischen Texas", in Galizien, steigt die Ölforderung auf ihr Maximum. Österreich rangiert eine Zeit lang unter den Big Playern des globalen Erdolgeschafts. Eine Reise zuruck zur Geburtsstunde des Autos in Österreich mit Andreas Pfeifer und Mariella Gittler. R: Martin Vogg, Florian Riedelsperger

In Anekdoten erzahlen sie den Wandel des heimischen FuSSballs uber die Jahrzehnte, behandeln aber auch viel Personliches. Robert Altenburger erzahlt die Geschichten der beiden Legenden Krankl und Prohaska. programme.title: Container Wars
programme.desc: From now on, it is also made in the port: In the new series "Container Wars", the content of large ship containers from all over the world comes under the hammer. In this rapid business, however, not only a thick wallet is needed, but also a good eye and iron nerves to be successful. The auctioners only have a few minutes to get a first impression of the container. Therefore, you only know after the auction whether it was worth it or not. programme.title: Lena Lorenz - cross and queer / Lena Lorenz - Kreuz und queer
programme.desc: After Alex gave birth to her daughter, she is headed by Franzi's claims to total equality, especially since the maintenance for the family has to be secured. As the lawy gets an interesting job offer, Franzi develops fears. As a freelance artist, she fuses that her idea of commonality will be able to do this into a classic role distribution and that this will destroy her love in the end. After the separation of Aimee Benzweiler, Vinz Huber and Eva Lorenz have to redefine their relationship to each other. In addition, Eva suffers from her sister Liesl. A serious pronunciation between the sisters reveals unusable contrasts. / Nachdem Alex ihre Tochter zur Welt gebracht hat, fuhlt sie sich von Franzis Anspruchen auf totale Gleichberechtigung uberfordert, zumal der Unterhalt fur die Familie gesichert werden muss.Als die Juristin ein interessantes Jobangebot bekommt, entwickelt Franzi Ängste. Sie als freischaffende Kunstlerin befurchtet, dass ihre Idee von Gemeinsamkeit in eine allzu klassische Rollenverteilung munden und dies am Ende ihre Liebe zerstoren wird.Um Beziehungen geht es auch auf dem Lorenzhof: Wahrend Lena Lorenz Rob Manzini vermisst, der sich fur einige Zeit im Ausland aufhalt, hat Bastian Pfeiffer eine neue Liebe gefunden. Nach der Trennung von Aimee Benzweiler mussen Vinz Huber und Eva Lorenz ihr Verhaltnis zueinander neu definieren. Daruber hinaus leidet Eva unter dem ubergriffigen Verhalten ihrer Schwester Liesl. Eine ernsthafte Aussprache zwischen den Schwestern bringt unuberbruckbare Gegensatze zum Vorschein.

programme.title: Lena Lorenz - Life is now / Lena Lorenz - Das Leben ist jetzt
programme.desc: Ina and Felipe Pious look forward to their first child. When Ina feels a knot in her chest, she turns to her midwife Lena Lorenz. A world collapses with the finding. Ina's cancer diagnosis takes place in the second trimester of your pregnancy, so chemotherapy could be started - the photo goods were sufficiently used. Ina hardly has time to find its way in the situation. Can Lena give her courage again? The veterinarian couple Ina and Felipe Pious has recently settled in the area with his own practice. Both dreams of a large family life. But not only that Ina has a difficult way with chemotherapy, it is already clear that she will not be able to get any other children. However, the relief at Lena is limited - her Ina's fate is too close. In this situation, she is rasped by Rob Uberrascht, who has returned from Kyrgyzstan, because he missed Lena. His close is good for her. Eva and Vinz also enjoy that they have found each other again. Only the difficult relationship with her sister Liz is burdened by EVA. There are also problems for Schorschi Striebel: The master mayor is under pressure, because after the takeover of the city clinic by an investor, the birth station is over. / Ina und Felipe Fromme freuen sich auf ihr erstes Kind. Als Ina einen Knoten in ihrer Brust ertastet, wendet sie sich an ihre Hebamme Lena Lorenz. Mit dem Befund bricht eine Welt zusammen.Inas Krebsdiagnose erfolgt im zweiten Trimester ihrer Schwangerschaft, somit konnte eine Chemotherapie begonnen werden - der Fotus ware ausreichend geschutzt. Ina hat kaum Zeit, sich in der Situation zurechtzufinden. Kann Lena ihr wieder Lebensmut vermitteln?Das Tierarztehepaar Ina und Felipe Fromme hat sich erst vor Kurzem mit eigener Praxis in der Gegend niedergelassen. Beide traumten von einem kinderreichen Familienleben. Doch nicht nur, dass Ina mit einer Chemotherapie einen schweren Weg vor sich hat, auch ist schon jetzt klar, dass sie keine weiteren Kinder wird bekommen konnen.Die Wollschweine auf dem Lorenzhof haben einen gewohnlichen Virusinfekt, der gut behandelbar ist. Die Erleichterung bei Lena halt sich jedoch in Grenzen - zu sehr geht ihr Inas Schicksal nahe.In dieser Situation wird sie von Rob uberrascht, der fruher aus Kirgistan zuruckgekehrt ist, weil er Lena vermisst hat. Seine Nahe tut ihr gut. Auch Eva und Vinz genieSSen es, dass sie wieder zueinandergefunden haben. Lediglich die schwierige Beziehung zu ihrer Schwester Liz belastet Eva.Probleme gibt es auch fur Schorschi Striebel: Der Burgermeister steht unter Druck, denn nach der Übernahme der stadtischen Klinik durch einen Investor steht die Geburtsstation vor dem Aus.

programme.title: AfD - ascent in the escape crisis / AfD - Aufstieg in der Fluchtlingskrise
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the AfD dumped only three to four percent for surveys. Then came the escape crisis. Since then, the party's success has been going through the ceiling and since then Angela Merkel has been considered to be an involuntary campaign helper in the extreme right. Because her sentence from 2015: "We are increasingly provoking the opponents of their escape policy. The party will be on a crossroads in 2015. Their original topic, the euro, no longer pulls. The economic -liberal camp led by party grinder Bernd Lucke is to be disempowered. The challengers are the then co. Chairman Frauke Petry and the so-called flight, a national-nationalist current current in the party. Faring dessels are a million people in Europe-from Syria, Afghanistan, Iraq, Albania. The federal government is initially undecided how one deals with this huge challenge. On August 31, 2015, Angela Merkel finally says her iconic sentence at her summer press conference: "We can do it." First there is a mood: uncertainty and frustration in part of the population, which is ignored by established politics. Then the AfD grabs - with radical slogans and sharp tones. She uses the overwhelming of the authorities to fill the topic of migration and to make political capital from it. An ascent that makes the AfD moving into the Bundestag in 2017 and finds its preliminary high point in the election of the Bundestag election in 2025. - Jorg Meuthen, Beatrix von Storch, Uwe Wurlitzer, Andre Poggenburg, Hans-Thomas Tillschneider, Steffen Koniger and others deliver the inner perspective of the AfD between 2015 and 2017. They report on the internal power, the surrounding and how the escape situation reveals a new topic, which leads to further radicalization of the AfD. LAGESO (State Office for Health and Social Affairs) looks at the events: For him it was less an escape crisis, but "above all an administrative crisis - and evidence of the structural weak of German bureaucracy". The migration researcher Victoria Rietig and the journalists Robin Alexander, Justus Bender and David Gebhard arrange. / Noch vor zehn Jahren dumpelte die AfD bei Umfragen bei nur drei bis vier Prozent. Dann kam die Fluchtlingskrise. Seitdem geht der Erfolg der Partei durch die Decke.Und seitdem gilt Angela Merkel bei einigen als unfreiwillige Wahlkampfhelferin der extremen Rechten. Denn ihr Satz von 2015: "Wir schaffen das" provoziert zunehmend die Gegner ihrer Fluchtlingspolitik.Die Partei steht 2015 an einem Scheideweg. Ihr ursprungliches Thema, der Euro, zieht nicht mehr. Das wirtschaftsliberale Lager um Parteigrunder Bernd Lucke soll entmachtet werden. Herausforderer sind die damalige Co.-Vorsitzende Frauke Petry und der sogenannte Flugel, eine volkisch-nationalistische Stromung in der Partei.Wahrenddessen sind in Europa eine Million Menschen auf der Flucht - aus Syrien, Afghanistan, Irak, Albanien. Die Bundesregierung ist zunachst unentschlossen, wie man mit dieser riesigen Herausforderung umgeht. Am 31. August 2015 schlieSSlich sagt Angela Merkel auf ihrer Sommerpressekonferenz ihren mittlerweile ikonischen Satz: "Wir schaffen das."Zuerst ist da eine Stimmung: Unsicherheit und Frust in einem Teil der Bevolkerung, die von der etablierten Politik ignoriert wird. Dann greift die AfD zu - mit radikalen Parolen und scharfen Tonen. Sie nutzt die Überforderung der Behorden, um das Thema Migration zu besetzen und daraus politisches Kapital zu schlagen. Ein Aufstieg, der den Einzug der AfD in den Bundestag im Jahr 2017 moglich macht und im Wahlergebnis der Bundestagswahl 2025 seinen vorlaufigen Hohepunkt findet.Der Film erzahlt vom Wechselspiel zwischen gesellschaftlicher Stimmung, uberforderten Institutionen und einer Partei, die das entstehende Vakuum mit Populismus fullt. - Jorg Meuthen, Beatrix von Storch, Uwe Wurlitzer, Andre Poggenburg, Hans-Thomas Tillschneider, Steffen Koniger und andere liefern die Innensicht der AfD zwischen 2015 und 2017. Sie berichten von den internen Machtkampfen, den Umbruchen und wie die Fluchtlingssituation ein neues Thema eroffnet, das zu weiterer Radikalisierung der AfD fuhrt.Sebastian Muschter, damaliger Chef des Berliner LAGeSo (Landesamt fur Gesundheit und Soziales), betrachtet die Ereignisse nuchtern: Fur ihn war es weniger eine Fluchtlingskrise, sondern "vor allem eine Verwaltungskrise - und ein Beleg fur die strukturellen Schwachen der deutschen Burokratie".Die Migrationsforscherin Victoria Rietig und die Journalisten Robin Alexander, Justus Bender und David Gebhard ordnen ein.

programme.desc: Ten years after Angela Merkel's historical sentence "We can do this" Sarah Tacke relentlessly recorded: How has migration changed our country since 2015? Did we "make" it? In summer 2015, many people come to Germany, looking for asylum and perspectives. The overwhelming welcome culture often follows the overwhelming welcome culture - a sample test for politics and society begins. The documentary accompanies people who say today: "Yes, we did it." They tell of successful careers, new opportunities and a life in safety. The focus is particularly on Syrians, who have been forming the greatest immigration group since 2015 and whose stories stand for many, but the film by Julia Losch, Hanna Gunther and Sarah Tacke also shows the dark side: he highlights the debate about trigger criminality, shows current figures and backgrounds and let people say: "It is enough, Germany is at the limit." The documentation classifies why foreign suspects are overrised in crime statistics and shows how complex the reality is behind the numbers. "On the pulse" provides a differentiated picture: between integration success and social overwhelming, between hope and hard reality. Ten years after "We can do this" the documentation also asks: How is it going? How can we do it? The documentary is part of the "Am Pulse" series, in the scene-called ZDF presenter pursue the topics that move Germany. They hear, immerse yourself in the everyday life of the spectators and shed light on what effects the decisions of politics have on life in all parts of society. Haben wir es "geschafft"?Im Sommer 2015 kommen viele Menschen nach Deutschland, auf der Suche nach Asyl und Perspektiven. Auf eine uberwaltigende Willkommenskultur folgt vielfach die Überforderung - eine ZerreiSSprobe fur Politik und Gesellschaft beginnt.Die Dokumentation begleitet Menschen, die heute sagen: "Ja, wir haben es geschafft." Im Fokus stehen dabei besonders Syrerinnen und Syrer, die seit 2015 die groSSte Einwanderungsgruppe bilden und deren Geschichten beispielhaft fur viele stehen.Doch der Film von Julia Losch, Hanna Gunther und Sarah Tacke zeigt auch die Schattenseiten: Er beleuchtet die Debatte um Auslanderkriminalitat, zeigt aktuelle Zahlen und Hintergrunde und lasst Menschen zu Wort kommen, die sagen: "Es reicht, Deutschland ist am Limit." Die Willkommenskultur in Deutschland ist erschopft - die Integration am Limit.Die Stimmung ist schlecht, bei Kommunen, die an der Unterbringung von Gefluchteten verzweifeln, bei Beratungsstellen, die Fluchtlinge in Arbeit bringen wollen und bei den Gefluchteten selbst, die sich integrieren wollen, aber unter den starren Regeln leiden."Wir sind am Limit! Wir schaffen es nicht mehr", sagt Achim Brotel, Vorsitzender des Deutschen Landkreistags. Unterwegs in seinem Heimat-Landkreis im Neckar-Odenwald gibt Brotel offen zu, dass die Kapazitaten bei der Aufnahme Gefluchteter nahezu erschopft seien, und die Politik endlich die Migration starker begrenzen musse. Jeden Monat kommen in die 7000 Einwohner Gemeinde 50 neue Gefluchtete. Die Herausforderungen sind enorm: Die Unterstutzung der Ehrenamtlichen ist kaum noch da, zudem gibt es zu wenig Sprachkurse. Denn ausgerechnet dort, wo der Fachkraftemangel gelost werden soll, fehlt es an Personal.Auch die Situation an Deutschlands Schulen ist alarmierend. Dort fehlt es schon jetzt an bis zu 40.000 Lehrkraften. Schulleiterin Christiane Guhmann ist mittendrin in diesem System. Von den Grundschulern in der Essener Karlsschule haben etwa 60 Prozent einen Migrationshintergrund. "Zuwanderung ist herausfordernd, vor allem fur eine kleine Grundschule wie unsere", sagt Guhmann. Zu wenig Platz und zu wenig Personal. Eine Sporthalle fehlt, so dass der Sportunterricht regelmaSSig auf den Fluren stattfinden muss. "Wie wollen wir hier alle Kinder ordentlich ausbilden, geschweige denn gut integrieren?" Ratlosigkeit, auch wenn sie sich mit viel Engagement gegen die Probleme stemmen.Serdar Kazanci betreibt in Berlin-Kreuzberg einen Fischimbiss. Aber auch nur soweit, wie er sich an die Gesetze halt und an die gesellschaftlichen Normen." Gleich nebenan betreibt Ercan Yasaroglu ein Cafe und stoSSt in die gleiche Kerbe. programme.title: Gluckliche Beziehung trotz Kindheitstrauma: Geht das?
programme.desc: Machen uns fruhere Erfahrungen und Kindheitstraumata automatisch beziehungsfahig? Leon spricht fur mit Menschen, die sich als beziehungsunfahig bezeichnen.Ist Veranderung moglich? In einem Sozialexperiment berichten Menschen von ihren traumatischen Kindheitserfahrungen, Selbstzweifeln und Bindungsangsten. Von Prof. Franz Neyer erfahrt Leon, wie sehr fruhe Pragungen spatere Beziehungen beeinflussen konnen.Sind wir wirklich "Generation beziehungsunfahig"? Und wenn ja, woran liegt das? Die Menschen, die Psychologe Leon Windscheid fur dieses Experiment befragt, sagen von sich selbst, sie seien beziehungsunfahig. Sie teilen ihre personlichen Geschichten uber ihr erlebtes Trauma in der Kindheit und die dadurch entstandene Bindungsangst sowie den entstandenen Selbstzweifeln. Es wird deutlich, wie vielfaltig die Grunde fur solche Gefuhle sein konnen. Dabei entsteht ein bewegender Austausch uber Herausforderungen, Hoffnung und die Fahigkeit, wieder Vertrauen in Beziehungen zu finden.Zusammen mit Franz Neyer, Professor fur Personlichkeitspsychologie, geht Leon der Frage nach, welchen Zusammenhang es zwischen unseren fruheren Erfahrungen und den spateren Beziehungen gibt. Wie wirken sich unsere Denk- und Verhaltensmuster darauf aus?

programme.title: Studio 4 (E) / Στούντιο 4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Nancy Zambetoglou and Thanassis Anagnostopoulos continue for the third season in the renewed and even richer daily magazine themes. / H Νάνσυ Ζαμπέτογλου και ο Θανάσης Αναγνωστόπουλος, συνεχίζουν για τρίτη σεζόν στο ανανεωμένο και ακόμη πιο πλούσιο σε θεματολογία καθημερινό μαγκαζίνο.

programme.title: Connections / Συνδέσεις
programme.desc: Katerina Doukas is linked to Greece and the world and transmit what is happening and what concerns us and affects our daily lives. / Η Κατερίνα Δούκα συνδέεται με την Ελλάδα και τον κόσμο και μεταδίδουν ό,τι συμβαίνει και ό,τι μας αφορά και επηρεάζει την καθημερινότητά μας.

programme.title: The time machine (e) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Vicky Moscholiou - Part B. Our show returns to May 1967 and presents the wedding of the year between two idols of the time Vicky Moscholi and Mimi Domazo. The couple opened their own nightclub, which was a huge success. / Επεισόδιο: Βίκυ Μοσχολιού - Μέρος Β. Η εκπομπή μας γυρίζει πίσω στην Πρωτομαγιά του 1967 και παρουσιάζει το γάμο της χρονιάς ανάμεσα σε δύο είδωλα της εποχής τη Βίκυ Μοσχολιού και το Μίμη Δομάζο. Το ζευγάρι άνοιξε το δικό του νυχτερινό μαγαζί, το οποίο γνώρισε τεράστια επιτυχία.

programme.title: Life otherwise K2 E15 (E) / Η Ζωή Αλλιώς Κ2 Ε15 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Karpathos, Awesome Beauty. Karpathos is diverse and full of contrasts, you never get bored. An anxious place you either fall in love with or never go back. By turning it, after each turn you are surprised by how different you look at. / Επεισόδιο: Κάρπαθος, Αγέρωχη Ομορφιά. Πολυποίκιλη και γεμάτη αντιθέσεις η Κάρπαθος, ποτέ δεν την βαριέσαι. Ένας ανήσυχος τόπος που ή τον ερωτεύεσαι ή δεν ξαναπατάς. Γυρνώντας την, μετά από κάθε στροφή ξαφνιάζεσαι από το πόσο διαφορετικό τοπίο αντικρύζεις.

programme.title: We arrived! K1 E5 (E) / Φτάσαμε! Κ1 Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Evritania. A new adventure and many new friends are waiting for Zerom Kalouta in the new episode of the show, this time destined for the unique Evritania, a generous, imposing and visitor -friendly place. / Επεισόδιο: Ευρυτανία. Μια νέα περιπέτεια και πολλοί καινούριοι φίλοι περιμένουν τον Ζερόμ Καλούτα στο καινούριο επεισόδιο της εκπομπής, με προορισμό αυτή τη φορά τη μοναδική Ευρυτανία, έναν τόπο γενναιόδωρο, επιβλητικό αλλά και φιλικό προς τον επισκέπτη.

programme.title: News - Sports - Weather / Ειδήσεις - Αθλητικά - Καιρός
programme.desc: Watch the latest developments at national and international level and find out on time and objectively on the important issues of the news from the ERT news team. / Παρακολουθήστε τις τελευταίες εξελίξεις σε εθνικό αλλά και διεθνές επίπεδο και ενημερωθείτε έγκαιρα και αντικειμενικά για τα σημαντικά ζητήματα της επικαιρότητας από την ειδησεογραφική ομάδα της ΕΡΤ.

programme.title: The dressmaker / Ο Μόδιστρος
programme.desc: The relationships of a doctor and his wife are disturbed when she learns that her husband met an old girlfriend. He believes they are lovers. programme.title: New Life, New Hope: the species in danger of the Otago Peninsula / Nova Vida, Nova Esperança: As Especies em Perigo da Península de Otago
programme.desc: The delicate balance of nature is evident in the Otago Peninsula, New Zealand, where wildlife and people live closely proximity. The yellow-leather penguin and the-nox-nosy-navy-nava-nose, both in danger of extinction, create their puppies in forests distant from the coast. The threatened Albatroz-Real-do-North now enjoys the ideal conditions for his turbulent mating rituals and the consequent creation of the puppies in the sunsent and herb-covered promotion. Conservation measures also support the efforts of these animals to increase their population number. / O delicado equilíbrio da natureza está em evidencia na Península de Otago, na Nova Zelândia, onde a vida selvagem e as pessoas vivem em estreita proximidade. O pinguim-de-olhos-amarelos e o leao-marinho-da-Nova-Zelândia, ambos em perigo de extinçao, criam os seus filhotes em florestas distantes da costa. O ameaçado albatroz-real-do-norte agora desfruta das condições ideais para os seus rituais de acasalamento turbulentos e a consequente criaçao dos filhotes no promontorio ventoso e coberto de ervas. Medidas de conservaçao tambem apoiam os esforços destes animais para aumentar o seu número populacional.

programme.title: The Chagos Islands - The hope of coral reefs? / As Ilhas Chagos - A Esperança dos Recifes de Coral?
programme.desc: In the middle of the Indian Ocean, more than 1,500 km from the closer continent, is a mysterious and untouched archipelago? The Chagos Islands. This group of 60 islands and one of the last untouched wild areas of the Earth. The archipelago of Chagos and one of the largest national national parks in the world and is strictly protected. A scientific expedition obtained access to this territory for the first time to realize how and that coral reefs behave in places with little human interference. In a journey towards the unknown, we follow in the footsteps of international renowned scientists who seek to unravel secrets and get surprising information about one of the last true wild areas of planet Earth. / No meio do Oceano Índico, a mais de 1.500 km do continente mais proximo, encontra-se um arquipelago misterioso e intocado ? as Ilhas Chagos. Este grupo de 60 ilhas e uma das últimas áreas selvagens intocadas da Terra. O Arquipelago de Chagos e um dos maiores parques nacionais marinhos do mundo e e rigorosamente protegido. Uma expediçao científica obteve acesso a este territorio pela primeira vez, para perceber como e que os recifes de coral se comportam em locais com pouca interferencia humana. Numa jornada rumo ao desconhecido, seguimos os passos de cientistas de renome internacional, que procuram desvendar segredos e obter informações surpreendentes sobre uma das últimas verdadeiras áreas selvagens do planeta Terra.

programme.title: Paris vs Tottenham Hotspur - UEFA Super Cup 2025 - Mini Match

Liverpool vs AFC Bournemouth - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 1
programme.desc: Liverpool have won 11 of their last 12 Premier League games against Bournemouth, with the exception being a 1-0 away loss in March 2023. Bournemouth have taken just one point from 24 available away against Liverpool in the Premier League, losing their last six visits to Anfield by an aggregate score of 23-2.

programme.title: Aston Villa vs Newcastle United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 1
programme.desc: Aston Villa beat Newcastle 4-1 in April, but haven’t won consecutive Premier League games against the Magpies since completing the double over them in 2004-05. Newcastle have lost five of their last six Premier League away games against Aston Villa, with the exception being a 3-1 victory in January 2024.

programme.title: Wolverhampton Wanderers vs Manchester City - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 1 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Wolves have lost nine of their last 10 Premier League meetings with Manchester City, although their one victory in this period did come at Molineux early in the season, winning 2-1 in September 2023 under Gary O’Neil. Across the last five Premier League campaigns, Manchester City have won the joint-most games and scored the most goals of any side when facing Wolves at Molineux.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Crystal Palace - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 1- Mini Match
programme.desc: Chelsea are unbeaten in their last 15 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, their longest active run against any of the 19 other sides involved in the 2025-26 season. Crystal Palace’s last victory at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League came in April 2017 under Sam Allardyce – since then, they’ve failed to win on any of their last eight trips in league action, losing seven of those matches.

programme.title: Ligue 1 Weekly Review - 2025/2026
programme.desc: Each Ligue 1 Match week is condensed into a 52-minute highlights show. Every game, goal, penalty, red card and everything in between is squeezed into an action-packed hour to ensure no football fan misses a kick across the game season.

programme.title: Leeds United vs Everton - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 1
programme.desc: Leeds United have only won one of their last 11 Premier League meetings with Everton, and are winless in each of the most recent five. Everton are unbeaten in their last five Premier League away games against Leeds United, which is their joint-longest active run away to any of the other 19 current top-flight teams.

programme.title: Mallorca vs Barcelona - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 1 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Only against Real Madrid have Mallorca suffered more defeats in their LaLiga history than against Barcelona. Barcelona have won 14 away games against Mallorca in LaLiga in the 21st Century, their joint-highest number of away wins against a single opponent in the competition during this period.

programme.title: Nantes vs PSG - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 1 - Mini Match
programme.desc: Nantes have conceded at least one goal in each of their last 28 matches against Paris SG in Ligue 1, last keeping a clean sheet in February 2006. Paris SG are the team that has beaten Nantes most often at home in Ligue 1. FCN have lost 10 of their last 13 home games against PSG.

programme.title: Sunderland vs West Ham United - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 1

programme.desc: Dive into the excitement of French handball with Liqui Moly Starligue, formerly LNH Division 1. Established in 1952, this premier league event features 16 top teams battling for glory. With Montpellier’s 14 Handball titles and Paris Saint-Germains 11 wins, the competition is fierce. Champions earn spots in the EHF Champions League, while cup winners qualify for the European League.

programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Shadman Vs Lestrez / Borilački sport - MMA: Shadman vs Lestrez
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Boks: Marc Castro - John Moraga
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Borilački Sport - MMA: Finals Alfie Davis vs Gadzhi Rabadanov / Borilački sport - MMA: Finals Alfie Davis vs Gadzhi Rabadanov
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The league performs 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: FUDBAL - PORTUGALSKA Liga: Estrela - Benfica / Fudbal - Portugalska liga: Estrela - Benfica
programme.desc: Founded in 1934. As a trial project, the Portuguese league was later given his official version called Primeira. In today's league system, 18 teams where each team plays one domestic and a visiting game with each club. A total of 70 clubs performed in the first league of Portugal, but only five conquered the title of the champion. The most won titles behind him has Lisbon Benfica. Two last placed teams drop out in Segundo, another Portuguese league. / Osnovana 1934. kao probni projekat, portugalska liga je četiri godine kasnije dobila i svoju službenu verziju nazvanu Primeira. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 18 ekipa gde svaka ekipa igra po jednu domaću i gostujuću utakmicu sa svakim klubom. Ukupno je 70 klubova nastupalo u prvoj ligi Portugala, no samo pet ih je osvajalo titulu prvaka. Najviše osvojenih titula iza sebe ima lisabonska Benfika. Dve poslednjeplasirane ekipe ispadaju u Segundu, drugu portugalsku ligu.

The Champion Cup was established, the annual continental competition in which only the champions of their states are performed. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became a television the most watched football event on the planet. The most conquered titles of the Champions of Europe has Madrid Giant Real. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. programme.title: Fudbal - Evrope League: Rangers - Lyon / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Rangers - Lyon
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Besiktas - Bahcesehir / Košarka - Turska liga: Besiktas - Bahcesehir
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Olympiacos - MacCabi / Košarka - Euroleague: Olympiacos - Maccabi
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. programme.title: Hockey - KHL: Salavat - Lokomotiv, PF1 G3 / Hokej - KHL: Salavat - Lokomotiv, PF1 G3
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. And since then the competition is spreading to increasingly European and Asian countries and thus becomes an unofficial other Hockey League of the world after the American-Canadian NLA. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL Plejofa received a prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed the Russian team wins the title of Russia Champions. Since 2011. The League except the clubs from the former USSR includes clubs from Central Europe, while since 2016. One Chinese representative enters first. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga sveta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa. Na kraju sezone pobednik KHL plejofa dobija prestižni Gagarin Kup, dok najbolje plasirana Ruska ekipa osvaja titulu šampiona Rusije. Od 2011. ligu osim klubova iz bivšeg SSSR-a ulaze klubovi iz centralne Evrope, dok od 2016. po prvi put ulazi i jedan Kineski predstavnik.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: Locomotive - Unics / Košarka - VTB liga: Lokomotiv - UNICS
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine were also involved. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Belorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - Russian League: Spartak - Zenit / Fudbal - Ruska liga: Spartak - Zenit
programme.desc: The Russian Football League recorded his competition beginnings since 1936. Even though soccer in the federal area played since 1900. The most successful team during that time is Moscow Spartak Although the beginning of the second part of the century is more successful clubs like CSKA Moscow and Zenith from St. Petersburg. League until the season 2012/2013. She played in the period spring - autumn for a long winter and has been played classically European autumn since then. Great financial investments in Russian football clubs have much closer to the league at the UEFINE LEASTICS of the first league coefficients in force in Europe. / Ruska fudbalska liga kao naslednik Sovjetskog saveza beleži svoje takmičarske početke od 1936. godine iako se fudbal na području saveza igrao još od 1900ih. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Zadar - Mega Mis / Košarka - ABA liga: Zadar - Mega MIS

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Rudar - worker / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Rudar - Radnik
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Sloga - Borac / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Sloga - Borac
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: Join and follow many exciting events of mixed martial arts that take place around the world. programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Bonanza series is happening around 1860 in Nevada.Ben Cartwright, along with three sons, lives on the Ranch Ponderosa near the city of Virginia City off the coast of Lake Tahoe. / Serija Bonanza se dogaja okoli leta 1860 v Nevadi.Ben Cartwright skupaj s tremi sinovi živi na ranču Ponderosa v bližini mesta Virginia City ob obali jezera Tahoe.

programme.title: Dinastija
programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. The Black KRYSTLE family accepts cold, and the staff also look at it, and Black's stubborn and promiscuous daughter resent her. Although he is committed to Krystle, Blake spends a lot more time and attention to his company Denver-Carrington, so he doesn't even notice what Krystle is facing. Her only ally is Black's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views. / Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Blakova družina Krystle sprejme hladno, tudi osebje nanjo gleda zviška, Blakova trmasta in promiskuitetna hči pa ji zameri. Čeprav je predan Krystle, Blake veliko več časa in pozornosti namenja svojemu podjetju Denver-Carrington, zato niti ne opazi, s čim vse se Krystle sooča. Njen edini zaveznik je Blakov sin, Steven, ki pa se z očetom, zaradi različnih političnih pogledov, ne razume najbolje.

programme.title: Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. In each show, they address several topical topics that relate to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are at the same time researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and contemporary approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Lugano, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Lugano, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Lugano, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Lugano, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. Zmagovalec finalne tekme se bo uvrstil v Ligo Evrope v naslednji sezoni.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Koper, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Koper, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (m): Celje - Banic Ostrava, qualifications for conference league 2025/2026, finale / Nogomet (M): Celje - Banik Ostrava, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026, Finale
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. programme.title: Slovenian water circuit: Doblarec, documentary, Mon. / Slovenski vodni krog: Doblarec, dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Mihelčič Matjaz ... In the middle stream of the Soča River, a little from the idyllic town of Kanal, which reigns above the river, flows the Doblarec stream with a mysterious gorge. / R: Mihelčič Matjaž... V srednjem toku reke Soče se malo iz idiličnega mesteca Kanal, ki kraljuje nad reko, vanjo izliva potok Doblarec s skrivnostno sotesko.
programme.desc: Doblarec (or home lingerie) is the strongest right tributary of the Soča River in its middle stream. The rapid deepening of the Soča River in the quartar reduced his erosion base, so he carved a gorge containing some picturesque waterfalls. The waterfalls are also on tributaries. Behind the confluence with the cardboard, the Doblarec cut a deep, narrow gorge into the limestone. Under the bridge to Kolar, the gorge narrows into the troughs, deep 25-30 meters. In this secrets of the water landscape of the Doblarec stream, gorges and its wider water landscape, together with the city of Kanal, it is because of its hiding place to imagine how in the old days the Old Believers found a place to contact with transcendence. It was a group of people who otherwise understood the world than people in their surroundings. They lived and felt with nature, and in these dark parts of the gorge, where the sun rarely shines, they found peace and space for their rituals. / Doblarec (ali po domače Perilo) je najmočnejši desni pritok Soče v njenem srednjem toku. Hitro poglabljanje Soče v kvartarju mu je zniževalo erozijsko bazo, zato je izdolbel sotesko, v kateri je nekaj slikovitih slapov. Slapovi so tudi na pritokih. Za sotočjem z Lepenko je Doblarec v apnenec vrezal globoko, ozko sotesko. Pod mostom h Kolarju se soteska zoži v korita, globoka 25–30 metrov.V tej skrivnosti vodni krajini potoka Doblarec, soteske in njene širše vodne krajine skupaj z mestom Kanal si je prav zaradi njene skritosti mogoče predstavljati, kako so v starih časih staroverci tu našli prostor za stik z transcedenco.
